nodes.name: Loose Ends
nodes.author: Jeremy Longshore
nodes.description: Loose Ends turns unfinished local Git work into a quiet local Omarchy bar queue. Every five minutes it scans repositories under home for uncommitted edits, unpushed commits, old stashes, detached heads, and interrupted rebases, merges, cherry-picks, or bisects. It surfaces interrupted work urgently, otherwise oldest first. It makes no network calls and does not modify repositories. Discovery and Git reads are time and size bounded; if a cap is reached, the panel clearly says the scan is partial.

nodes.name: Capture Conveyor
nodes.author: Jeremy Longshore
nodes.description: Capture Conveyor turns Omarchy screenshots into a keyboard-first inbox, not a forgotten folder. The bar counts captures; open the panel for the newest 24, select with arrow keys, start a screenshot or OCR region, copy its path, or reveal its folder. It refreshes every 20 seconds. Its bounded scanner reads only top-level screenshot PNG names, paths, sizes, and timestamps. It never reads image pixels, OCRs existing files, watches your clipboard, uploads data, opens an account, or uses the network.

nodes.name: Workspace Storyboard
nodes.author: Jeremy Longshore
nodes.description: Workspace Storyboard turns your Omarchy bar into a local map of live Hyprland workspaces. See workspace window counts and the active window title, then click or use Up/Down, Enter, or 1-9 to jump back into context. It retains a clearable, capped re-entry trail of workspace IDs, titles, application classes, and timestamps in private local state. It makes no network requests, and its Hyprland reads and panel payload are time and byte bounded. It stores 40 events and shows the newest eight locally.

nodes.name: Quiet Queue
nodes.author: Jeremy Longshore
nodes.description: Quiet Queue adds a trustworthy focus switch to Omarchy. Start a 25- or 50-minute session, see the countdown in the bar, and return to normal notification delivery when it expires. It uses Omarchy's native Do Not Disturb service: silenced notifications stay in first-party history, and Quiet Queue never reads, uploads, replaces, or discards them. It turns DND off only when it owns the session; existing DND is left alone, and an external change revokes stale ownership. State checks every 5 seconds.

nodes.name: Agent Wool
nodes.author: Parker Brown
nodes.description: The whole flock on one wall — every coding agent's face, state and vitals, fed by the herd state bus

nodes.name: TrueNAS Apps Watcher
nodes.author: David Boulay
nodes.description: Watches a TrueNAS SCALE server for pending app upgrades and newer container images — and, through Portainer, for updates to the containers TrueNAS doesn't manage — and applies them from the bar.

nodes.name: Omachords
nodes.author: Kyle
nodes.description: Build and compare triads and seventh chords across tonal and chromatic pitch circles.

nodes.name: OpenProject Tasks
nodes.author: helderrscorreia
nodes.description: Open assigned OpenProject work packages with priorities, time tracking (start/stop timer), and comment labels.

nodes.name: Browser Switcher
nodes.author: Sven Strothoff
nodes.description: Switch which browser or isolated browser profile opened links go to, straight from the bar.

nodes.name: Local AI
nodes.author: 0xSero
nodes.description: Run a local model on your own GPU or CPU and open a coding agent on it. Local AI picks a model tested on your card (NVIDIA, Intel Arc Pro, AMD) or AVX2 CPU, checks its weights against Hugging Face and serves it in Docker behind a keyed, OpenAI-compatible gateway on 127.0.0.1. Opens pi, Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and five more agents without touching their config. Start: omarchy plugin add https://github.com/sybil-solutions/omarchy-local-ai --enable

nodes.name: Omadates
nodes.author: Gabbe2312
nodes.description: Apple Calendar in your Omarchy bar. Dots on the days that have something, today's events under the month grid, and a click for the details. Syncs iCloud, any CalDAV server, and webcal subscriptions.

nodes.name: Omalet
nodes.author: Ravi Vasavan
nodes.description: Owlet Smart Sock 3 vitals on the Omarchy bar: heart rate, blood oxygen, battery, skin temperature, movement, sleep, and desktop alerts. Unofficial Owlet cloud API; not a substitute for the Owlet app.

nodes.name: Tokscale
nodes.author: jwty
nodes.description: Tokscale token usage and spend widget for the Omarchy status bar.

nodes.name: Scratchpad Deck
nodes.author: TierTek
nodes.description: A visual scratchpad switcher for the Omarchy bar. Shows live previews of the windows hiding in your scratchpads and gives each one its own hotkey.

nodes.name: Hebrew Calendar & Zmanim
nodes.author: vbtwo
nodes.description: Date label with a calendar popup that pairs every Gregorian day with its Hebrew date, marks days that carry a holiday or a note, and shows holiday info, candle-lighting and Shabbat/holiday-end times for the day you click.

nodes.name: Seismic Atlas
nodes.author: Pieter Geutjens
nodes.description: Track earthquakes, volcanoes, tsunami bulletins, plate boundaries, and monitoring stations on a rotatable globe.

nodes.name: Audio Resolver
nodes.author: TechWhispers
nodes.description: Prepare camera footage for DaVinci Resolve on Linux by converting AAC audio to PCM in Resolve-ready .mov files without re-encoding video.

nodes.name: Dopewars
nodes.author: Ninepoint Labs
nodes.description: The classic dopewars (Drug Wars) turn-based trading game, the whole single-player game living in a bar panel. Your game is saved after every move, so take a turn whenever you feel like it.

nodes.name: OmaResume
nodes.author: jimg4
nodes.description: Save a window inventory and recover supported applications after login.

nodes.name: ThreatSpire CTI
nodes.author: jfaulhefer
nodes.description: Live CTI metrics from a ThreatSpire tenant in the Omarchy bar: honeypot observations, adversary IPs, IOCs, credential attempts, and campaign activity. Authenticates with a ThreatSpire API key generated on your profile page.

nodes.name: Wireless Display Cast
nodes.author: shady
nodes.description: Open the Miracast receiver picker and check wireless display prerequisites using GNOME Network Displays.

nodes.name: Wi-Fi Privacy
nodes.author: Loupi
nodes.description: MAC address randomization, DHCP hostname cloaking, and Wi-Fi tracking protection for Omarchy.

nodes.name: Omaclippr
nodes.author: dooooooks
nodes.description: Background instant replay buffer to capture your best gaming moments and desktop highlights on demand.

nodes.name: Display and Color Controls
nodes.author: tdownie0
nodes.description: Display brightness, scale and laptop controls, plus advanced color controls (brightness, temperature, gamma, inversion) via wl-gammarelay.

nodes.name: Omableep
nodes.author: Jankees van Woezik
nodes.description: Retro soundboard: chip sounds synthesised on the spot, machine sounds from real recordings.

nodes.name: Folder Shelf
nodes.author: samara-hub-ro
nodes.description: A glass shelf on your desktop holding the folders you actually use: hover one to see inside it — thumbnails, recent files, size, composition and permissions — and open it in your file manager with a double click.

nodes.name: BibleTales
nodes.author: Shirak Semonian
nodes.description: One Bible story a day, told as literature. A calm bar widget that opens a beautifully typeset reading pane: every day brings one installment of a classic story (3-4 short chapters to page through) written in modern literary English with no preaching and no church jargon — just drama, imagery and a quiet cliffhanger that makes you look forward to tomorrow. Deterministic day rotation, fully offline reading; an optional read-aloud button speaks the day-part through Edge TTS (no key, no tracking).

nodes.name: OmaIce
nodes.author: TerrifiedBug
nodes.description: Ice-style hidden section for the bar: everything left of the chevron hides, plus the system tray.

nodes.name: Remminarchy
nodes.author: Sorena100
nodes.description: Remmina remote desktop profiles and active sessions in the Omarchy bar.

nodes.name: Barkeep
nodes.author: Nine Point Labs
nodes.description: Keyboard-driven overlay that tends your Omarchy bar: see every installed shell plugin, switch it on or off, slide it along the bar, pin it to the center, pull updates, remove what you no longer pour, and keep named bar profiles you switch between from the bar.

nodes.name: AI Hub
nodes.author: Johan Lopez
nodes.description: Ollama service control, coding-agent usage, launch shortcut, default-agent switching, and custom agent harnesses in one Omarchy bar panel.

nodes.name: hypr-dwm-land
nodes.author: Person1873
nodes.description: DWM-style tags for Hyprland (Lua module + bar widget)

nodes.name: Pigeon
nodes.author: xyzlab
nodes.description: ntfy inbox in the bar. Streams messages from ntfy.sh or your own server into a themed panel with topic tabs, search, toasts, unread badge, click and http actions, attachments, and a compose box. Token or basic auth.

nodes.name: Pixel Shift
nodes.author: Arseniy Zarechnev
nodes.description: OLED burn-in protection for the bar: walks its edge padding and center a few pixels back and forth, too slowly to notice

nodes.name: Zorkmachy
nodes.author: Ninepoint Labs
nodes.description: Zork I, II and III in a bar panel. The original Infocom games (MIT-licensed by Microsoft) run on the frotz Z-machine interpreter; every move is saved, so you can pick up the adventure whenever you like.

nodes.name: Football Tracker
nodes.author: bekkenes
nodes.description: Tracks your favorite football teams: match-day and kickoff notifications, live goal/card/substitution alerts, and a bar widget with upcoming fixtures.

nodes.name: Praefectus OpenCode
nodes.author: jcergolj
nodes.description: Live OpenCode agent counts and session switching in the Omarchy bar.

nodes.name: Speech to Text
nodes.author: alanfortlink
nodes.description: Dictation with a live waveform and live text in the bar, a browsable history of every recording and its transcript, and configurable keys per language (toggle, and toggle + Return). Uses the same local Whisper engine Omarchy ships (voxtype) by default; other engines are configurable.

nodes.name: Stargazer
nodes.author: chrhicks
nodes.description: Hourly observing weather, Moon position and astronomical darkness in your Omarchy theme.

nodes.name: OmCursor Forge
nodes.author: Erik Burdett
nodes.description: Forge retro pixel-art mouse cursors from the bar — theme-matched colors, a lich's skeletal hand, a sword, a wand, or your own image.

nodes.name: Tally
nodes.author: Ruben Assink
nodes.description: Your payments in the Omarchy bar: balance, payouts, recent payments, and a notification when you get paid, refunded, disputed, or paid out. Stripe today, more providers to come.

nodes.name: OmaSpaces
nodes.author: TerrifiedBug
nodes.description: Mission-Control-style overview: workspaces across, grouped tabs down, live thumbnails, opened by a three-finger swipe up.

nodes.name: Update Center
nodes.author: Saiiiiiph
nodes.description: One quiet indicator for pending system, AUR, Flatpak, and Omarchy plugin updates.

nodes.name: RSS news
nodes.author: Marius Ghizdavet
nodes.description: An RSS reader in the Omarchy bar: the unread count, the items in a panel, mark-all-read, and feed management. Speaks 10 languages, following the system locale by default.

nodes.name: Rain Radar Belgium & Netherlands
nodes.author: dzanaga
nodes.description: Buienradar rain forecast for Belgium and the Netherlands

nodes.name: Keypad
nodes.author: mfilm
nodes.description: Turn a 12-key, 2-knob macropad into a programmable control surface — built for the Sikai pad (USB 1189:8840), over USB or Bluetooth. Draws your pad, and clicking a key or a knob assigns it a command. Layers are done in software, because these pads report the same keycodes on every hardware layer and say nothing when their layer button is pressed.

nodes.name: NewsFlash
nodes.author: Shirak Semonian
nodes.description: Daily world news in a minimalist bar widget. One-time IP geolocation opens the edition of the country you are in (190+ countries; localized sections, English search feed elsewhere). Lead story with optional image over a compact list with LIVE markers and relative times. Click a headline to read the full article inside the panel (local extraction). Read-aloud in the edition's own language (edge-tts). Quiet polling (5-60 min) via Google News RSS with BBC/Guardian fallback. No key, no tracking.

nodes.name: Spectra
nodes.author: Kevin Cardwell
nodes.description: Audio spectrum for the Omarchy bar. Seven styles from bars and beads to spikes, steps and curves, in stereo, coloured by your theme or the album art; one shared cava capture, and one shader that draws only the frames that change.

nodes.name: PICO-8 Widget
nodes.author: Guy Kroizman
nodes.description: A daily PICO-8 game in the bar: cover, description and a link to play it on lexaloffle.com. Bookmark games you want to come back to.

nodes.name: Hidden Wi-Fi
nodes.author: dimef; based on Omarchy
nodes.description: Omarchy network panel with an inline form for connecting to hidden Wi-Fi networks.

nodes.name: Grace Window
nodes.author: CoolJam
nodes.description: Reopen recently closed window, including its content with SUPER+SHIFT+W. The plugin rebinds SUPER+W to move the focused window silently to workspace 10 with a one-minute reopen grace period until it gets closed for real. You can configure the keybindings, hidden window look, grace period, … (see README for more)! Disabling or uninstalling the plugin via omarchy's plugin system removes its managed block from "~/.config/hypr/bindings.lua" automatically to restore your previous keybindings.

nodes.name: Advanced Displays
nodes.author: Fredrik Öhrström
nodes.description: Per-display resolution, arrangement, refresh rate, scale, rotation, mirroring, VRR, HDR, brightness and arrangement, with safe apply and persistence to monitors.lua

nodes.name: Grammarchy
nodes.author: kszx11
nodes.description: A local-first English grammar map and learning widget for the Omarchy bar.

nodes.name: Wyoming Read Aloud
nodes.author: chalkers
nodes.description: Read selected text through a configurable Wyoming TTS server, with buffered sentence playback and native player controls.

nodes.name: OmaThock
nodes.author: TerrifiedBug
nodes.description: Mechanical keyboard sounds on every keypress. No input group, no binary, no installer: Hyprland's Lua event bus feeds a small Python mixer outside the shell. Plays thock, Mechvibes and MechvibesDX soundpacks unchanged.

nodes.name: Rock Arch
nodes.author: ONE&ALL
nodes.description: Bridging Rock RMS and Omarchy

nodes.name: OClocky
nodes.author: kingnick
nodes.description: LED alarm-clock bar widget plus analog desktop clock, calendar, media, and quote cards on empty monitors.

nodes.name: Git Radar
nodes.author: Ozan Özdil
nodes.description: Developer activity pulse, live git commit tracker, multi-repo status monitor, and Wayland clipboard integration for Omarchy Linux.

nodes.name: Hyprpin
nodes.author: Jon Kinney
nodes.description: Keeps chosen windows visible when you switch away from their workspace: moved onto a display of their own, parked in a corner, or tucked into the scratchpad. Compositor-level picture-in-picture for video calls.

nodes.name: Hotkey HUD
nodes.author: Dagyr
nodes.description: Floating keystroke HUD overlay and status bar indicator for pressed hotkeys and window manager shortcuts.

nodes.name: Bananet
nodes.author: banan
nodes.description: Bananet — where does your traffic go? Networks, tunnels, egress route and per-service connections in the Omarchy bar: Wi-Fi, Ethernet, Tailscale, ZeroTier, WireGuard / MikroTik Back To Home, OpenVPN, public IP and its owner, live throughput with 24 h charts, routes, DNS, which services talk to which addresses over which link, and alerts when the egress link, the public IP or the listening services change.

nodes.name: Yandex Music
nodes.author: vornashev
nodes.description: Native Yandex Music player with catalog, owned-playlist management, library, queue and MPRIS

nodes.name: OChessy
nodes.author: kingnick
nodes.description: Chess.com stats on the bar, local Stockfish game review, and allowlisted lesson links.

nodes.name: Omostrich
nodes.author: tim
nodes.description: Local Nostr signer and note composer for Omarchy. One bar chip to unlock your locally encrypted Nostr key, compose and post kind-1 notes, approve NIP-46 signing requests from other Nostr apps, and manage relays and authorized apps. Plus a compose-only hotkey overlay (SUPER + N). Not a feed or client; your private key never leaves the local vault.

nodes.name: Dashboard DL
nodes.author: TheFlngDutchman
nodes.description: Clock with calendar, media, system and weather dashboard, plus a yt-dlp download button for whatever is playing

nodes.name: Fat Cat Pomodoro
nodes.author: jeremielumandong
nodes.description: A cozy cat sanctuary for your Pomodoro breaks, with persistent timers, personalities, and a growing collection.

nodes.name: Clipboard History
nodes.author: alanfortlink
nodes.description: Raycast-style clipboard history: fuzzy search over content, type, app and date, with rich per-type previews

nodes.name: Omakanvas
nodes.author: Erik Bourget
nodes.description: Canvas bar widget supporting multiple login methods, persisting your course information so you can ask your agents about it, and more.

nodes.name: omaTrail
nodes.author: Jeremy Longshore
nodes.description: omaTrail launches frontier survival from the Omarchy bar. Name your party, pack a wagon, set pace/rations, cross rivers, face illness, trade, and hunt wildlife. Choose original omaTrail rules or an independently built Classic 1978-inspired profile. Play either in Green Monitor or Color Deluxe graphics by keyboard or mouse. Offline only: no network, telemetry, account, daemon, or elevated access. Saves keep a backup. Design: https://gist.github.com/jeremylongshore/f6bfa2df134361ec33faa552a6df56d1

nodes.name: Omasnake
nodes.author: Faeric
nodes.description: A theme-aware monochrome Snake game for the Omarchy bar, inspired by classic mobile phones.

nodes.name: Chromatic Tuner
nodes.author: bronder
nodes.description: Chromatic instrument tuner with large note display, flat-to-sharp pitch meter, configurable in-tune tolerance, reference pitch, instrument presets, and an inline grouped source list for microphones, USB/built-in devices, and multichannel audio interfaces.

nodes.name: Tablet Toggle
nodes.author: ngek202
nodes.description: Tablet-mode toggle bar-widget for convertible laptops. Left-click toggles tablet mode; right-click runs an interactive health check (repair only if problems are found). If the companion package is missing, either click installs it visibly (pinned, idempotent). After install: SUPER+B = on-screen keyboard (SAM OSK) · SUPER+SHIFT+T = tablet mode · 3-finger swipes = pages and tablet exit. Companion to the tablet-kbd package.

nodes.name: DualSense
nodes.author: Atos Lins
nodes.description: PlayStation DualSense battery, lightbar, player LEDs, adaptive triggers, audio, rumble and a live input tester in the bar

nodes.name: DictDrawer
nodes.author: mbelli
nodes.description: A sliding Voxtype and Handy history drawer with persistent local transcripts, full-history search, and one-click copy

nodes.name: Remote servers
nodes.author: Majkelll
nodes.description: Keep a list of your own SSH servers in the bar: open a console, watch live load/RAM/uptime, and get told when one drops or comes back. One button sets up key-based auth, so no password is ever stored or asked for again.

nodes.name: Remote Desktop
nodes.author: Kostadin Kadiev
nodes.description: Share your existing Omarchy desktop over RDP with simple setup, private-network binding and native shell controls.

nodes.name: Aura Blur
nodes.author: Yeshuah Franco
nodes.description: Adds a continuous, high-quality radial blur around Omarchy popups and OSDs.

nodes.name: OMEN Tastaturfarben
nodes.author: Kevin
nodes.description: Vier RGB-Zonen mit WASD-Fokus für HP OMEN (Board 8C77). Manuelle Treibereinrichtung erforderlich.

nodes.name: paperless-ngx-inbox
nodes.author: Sebastian & Gemini CLI
nodes.description: Paperless-ngx inbox and document manager in your top bar

nodes.name: Caffeine Curve
nodes.author: Late Compile
nodes.description: Log a coffee with one click, watch it decay in the bar, and see what is still in you at bedtime.

nodes.name: FossFetch
nodes.author: davedes
nodes.description: Search for open-source alternatives to proprietary apps and install them with one click (pacman / AUR / Flatpak).

nodes.name: Mise dotfiles
nodes.author: FilipHarald
nodes.description: Dotfile sync health and watcher controls for mise

nodes.name: IPTV
nodes.author: Sam Blakeman
nodes.description: Single-provider IPTV browser for Omarchy (m3u / Xtream, Live + VOD, XMLTV EPG, favorites, fullscreen TV mode). Themed via shell tokens; playback in external mpv.

nodes.name: Omareel
nodes.author: hadijaveed
nodes.description: Record your screen, camera, and voice on Omarchy. Save locally or share a link from your own storage. Optional Studio adds click zooms, backgrounds, and frames for polished demos and tutorials.

nodes.name: YouTube Float
nodes.author: jcputney
nodes.description: Pick up where you left off on YouTube, browse subscriptions and search, and play the result in a floating, pinned mpv window.

nodes.name: Owlook
nodes.author: Rafael Peña-Azar
nodes.description: CI, deploy, and queue status for your projects, in the bar.

nodes.name: Mouseless
nodes.author: Bill Kuehler
nodes.description: Keyboard-driven mouse pointer: type a short label to warp the pointer and click, with right, middle, and double click, move-only, and a scroll mode.

nodes.name: VisiGrid Scratch
nodes.author: VisiGrid
nodes.description: A persistent scratch spreadsheet that drops down over your desktop. Replaces the calculator: type numbers and formulas, it remembers them, and the real VisiGrid engine does the math.

nodes.name: OmaQ
nodes.author: hancore
nodes.description: Invite-only 1:1 and group chat for the Omarchy bar.

nodes.name: Nvag Pulse
nodes.author: Shirak Semonian
nodes.description: Quiet database environment monitor for the Omarchy bar: auto-detects local Docker database containers, polls remote SQL servers with reachability + latency and password-less engine health probes, and only draws attention when something is down.

nodes.name: JotPin
nodes.author: JotPin contributors
nodes.description: A quick Markdown scratchpad for the Omarchy shell.

nodes.name: Text to Speech
nodes.author: hikari
nodes.description: On-demand, local-first speech for selected text and anything visible on screen

nodes.name: Keyboard Layouts
nodes.author: madmatt and contributors
nodes.description: Keyboard layout switcher with variants, a default layout, and switching shortcuts

nodes.name: NTS Radio
nodes.author: Sam Fortin
nodes.description: An unofficial NTS Radio client for Omarchy: live NTS 1 and NTS 2 in the bar, plus a browser window for the archive with search, show and episode pages, tracklists, and a local library of saved shows and episodes. Plays locally through mpv or on a Chromecast.

nodes.name: Hermes Deck
nodes.author: mbot11
nodes.description: Live Hermes Agent companion for Omarchy: status, sessions, usage, kanban, controls, and a drop-down TUI.

nodes.name: Pages
nodes.author: Kvark
nodes.description: Visual editor for pages: see what is running and drag it where it belongs

nodes.name: Omapager
nodes.author: Neil Jagdish Patel
nodes.description: Notifications for Omarchy: a stacking, grouping replacement for the built-in service, with markup parsing, resolved source icons, inline reply, and per-source snooze.

nodes.name: Look & Feel Studio
nodes.author: Bohar
nodes.description: Interactive visual customization drawer for live window opacity, frosted glass blur, UI scaling, font sizes, and wallpaper rotation.

nodes.name: Omazork
nodes.author: Lucas Bertoni
nodes.description: Zork I/II/III console overlay with casual-mode pacing

nodes.name: Dopamine Text
nodes.author: Alessandro Zambon (z4mbo)
nodes.description: A playful typing counter, eighteen tiny particle effects, and optional gentle sounds.

nodes.name: Grammachy
nodes.author: jyooi
nodes.description: Grammar and spelling checks for any selected text

nodes.name: Skill Manager
nodes.author: Firstpick
nodes.description: Link unchanged local skills across Pi, OpenCode, Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex CLI, with compatibility warnings.

nodes.name: Screen Sharing Indicator
nodes.author: Dennis Thomsen
nodes.description: Presenter-visible red border around the window or monitor currently shared through the desktop portal. The audience sees at most a thin black strip on monitor captures, and nothing at all on window captures.

nodes.name: omathematic-backgrounds
nodes.author: Fernando Moro
nodes.description: An animated mathematical wallpaper that listens to what you play

nodes.name: Onote
nodes.author: lolu13
nodes.description: Sticky notes as tiled Hyprland windows, stored in SQLite, drawn by the shell itself

nodes.name: Bookmark Everything
nodes.author: decadentsavant
nodes.description: Keyboard-first launcher for bookmarked URLs, files, folders, and applications

nodes.name: Spotlight
nodes.author: Max Randhahn
nodes.description: A Raycast-style launcher for Omarchy. Spotlight launches applications, switches windows, finds files, searches clipboard history, runs Omarchy commands and toggles system settings such as Wi-Fi and night light from a single input. Natural-language input covers calculations, unit conversions, reminders and calendar events, and search prefixes route queries to sites such as YouTube and GitHub. Spotlight runs inside omarchy-shell and opens instantly, without a separate background process.

nodes.name: Quick Bridge
nodes.author: Colin Faulkingham
nodes.description: QR-code bridge to upload from a phone, share a file or clipboard, or proxy a local HTTP port over a Cloudflare quick tunnel.

nodes.name: SSHuttleDeck
nodes.author: jaabell
nodes.description: An SSHuttle SSH VPN tunnel launcher for SSH config aliases, Tailscale machines, and custom endpoints.

nodes.name: hyprpm Manager
nodes.author: TierTek
nodes.description: Hyprland native plugin health in the Omarchy bar. Warns you when hyprpm plugins are about to stop loading, and hands you the one command that fixes it.

nodes.name: Session Restore
nodes.author: David Reed
nodes.description: Save every open window — app, workspace, monitor, size, floating/fullscreen state, and working directory — as a named session. Restore it on demand, or pin one to reopen automatically at login (once per login; a mid-session shell restart will not re-fire it). Optional browser tab capture/restore (off by default) needs python3. Does NOT restore the tiled split arrangement within a workspace — see the README.

nodes.name: Hypertile
nodes.author: Jim Martin
nodes.description: Design zone layouts on your screen and let your windows follow. Split and resize zones over your live desktop, cycle layouts with SUPER+L, and send windows to numbered slots by keyboard or drag. Save app arrangements as scenes, arrange your monitors, and restore your desktop after login, all from one overlay, with a bar widget showing the current layout.

nodes.name: Aura Voxtype HUD
nodes.author: Yeshuah Franco
nodes.description: A voice-reactive Omarchy HUD that locally acquires and builds React Bits Strands.

nodes.name: Sony Headphones
nodes.author: Roy Kevin
nodes.description: Sony WH-1000XM5 Headphone Manager

nodes.name: Switchboard
nodes.author: leonaffi-byte
nodes.description: A compact AI usage dashboard with safe Claude account switching and optional automatic switching.

nodes.name: Theme Come True
nodes.author: mapleroyal
nodes.description: Introducing a top bar menu for easily switching between dark/light mode, themes, and wallpapers. Built, optimized, and reviewed by GPT 6 Astra Ultra.

nodes.name: Android Dev
nodes.author: CostaFot
nodes.description: A companion plugin for the typical stuff an Android developer does on the day-to-day: devices, packages, developer toggles, screenshots and recording, APKs, the emulator, scrcpy and wireless debugging.

nodes.name: Token Stats
nodes.author: Erik Burdett
nodes.description: Local LLM tokens per hour in the bar, with an exact-count graph, history, cloud comparison, and Claude Code / Codex agent tracking with a unified resumable sessions list

nodes.name: Omamesh
nodes.author: Josh Clarke
nodes.description: MeshCore companions, nodes, and messages in the Omarchy bar.

nodes.name: SimulNetDevice
nodes.author: mattyd-ip
nodes.description: Wi-Fi (wireless/WLAN) and Ethernet (wired/LAN) network status, connection state, internet ping, packet loss, and download/upload speed for dual/multiple network connections — live and simultaneous via NetworkManager — plus wireless network scanning, DHCP/static-IP address, gateway, and DNS configuration with saved profiles, primary-interface routing control, and Wi-Fi band selection.

nodes.name: Wallpaper Explorer
nodes.author: EF-Code
nodes.description: Browse and apply wallpapers from any installed Omarchy theme without changing theme colors.

nodes.name: ThemerToggle
nodes.author: l1qu1d
nodes.description: Your favorite light and dark themes, one click apart.

nodes.name: Disk Space
nodes.author: Erik Burdett
nodes.description: A circular disk usage meter with total, used and free space in a popup.

nodes.name: Omarchy Vitals
nodes.author: osesantos
nodes.description: Modular system monitor for the Omarchy bar: one independent entry per metric (CPU, memory, disk, network, sensors), each with its own widget style — text, sparkline, line, bars, pie, fill, or up/down speed — and a click-open detail panel with per-core graphs and top processes.

nodes.name: WM Actions
nodes.author: blafusel
nodes.description: Mouse-only floating panel of common Hyprland actions, clipboard, dictation, and a current-workspace window switcher

nodes.name: Agent Skills Manager
nodes.author: oliwier-xiao
nodes.description: Every skill, plugin and MCP server your coding agents load, in one list. Claude Code, OpenCode, Codex, Cursor and Pi each keep theirs in their own folders, and none of them will tell you what the other four are loading — or what it costs you in tokens on every turn. It reads; it does not write to anything an agent loads.

nodes.name: Plex Float
nodes.author: jcputney
nodes.description: Search your Plex library in a native overlay with poster art, and play the pick in a floating, pinned mpv window that follows you across every workspace.

nodes.name: Twitch Float
nodes.author: jcputney
nodes.description: Browse your live Twitch follows, categories and top channels in a native overlay, and play the pick in a floating, pinned mpv window.

nodes.name: PYIN News
nodes.author: chuchua.tech
nodes.description: Get the news. Keep your time. PYIN is a private, finite Omarchy reader with no bot replies, rage bait, popularity contests, or infinite scroll—just reporting you choose, transparent local curation, and optional on-demand AI.

nodes.name: Google Messages
nodes.author: MarcFord
nodes.description: Read and reply to Google Messages from the Omarchy bar

nodes.name: Jenkins Health
nodes.author: H3nr1 D14z
nodes.description: Jenkins health in the Omarchy bar: live polling of controller, nodes (workspace and /tmp disk), queue, jobs, and updates; notifications for outages, node and disk changes, job failures, queue backlogs, maintenance; opt-in live disk probing of agents (usable space and volume totals, percentage thresholds); critical at a third or more agents down; safe actions (quiet-down, cancel queue item, state-checked node toggles) plus an opt-in per-node workspace wipe (admin token, per-job checks).

nodes.name: Keystroke
nodes.author: Arseniy Zarechnev
nodes.description: A Raycast-style command palette that replaces the Omarchy menu, with voice, Codex and community extensions

nodes.name: Omarchy Island
nodes.author: luinbytes
nodes.description: Quickbar activity surface for live system state

nodes.name: OmaPen
nodes.author: stempelv
nodes.description: "Help me write" for Omarchy: rewrite whatever you have selected, or whatever you type into the panel, with the coding agent Omarchy already knows about

nodes.name: Sportmarchy
nodes.author: exquisiteskink
nodes.description: Follow MLB, MLS, NFL, NBA, and NHL teams from the Omarchy bar. Live scores rotate on the pill; the popup shows next games and opens ESPN.

nodes.name: Print Center
nodes.author: David Reed
nodes.description: Manage CUPS printers and the print queue from your Omarchy bar. A pill shows the default printer's state and queue depth, turning accent or urgent when a printer needs paper, ink, or attention. The popup lists printers with ink levels; cancel, hold, or release jobs; set your default; print a test page; add a driverless network printer. A headless service notifies you when a job finishes, is held, or a printer errors. A Scan tab drives SANE scanners (optional; installs its packages on request).

nodes.name: Familienfabrik.at

nodes.name: Omarchy Extras

nodes.description: A compact bar menu for the Omarchy Extras desktop collection, setup guide, and optional local dashboard.

nodes.name: Omarchy Help

nodes.name: Herdr Watch

nodes.name: Headroom

nodes.name: Kneadra

Handles same-day, overnight, multi-day cold, and cold-then-warm ferments, and plans when to mix from the time you want to bake.

nodes.name: I-Ching: Stalks & Sacred Marbles
nodes.author: Matthew Hudson
nodes.description: Authentic I-Ching divination using Andrew Kennedy's Revised Yarrow Algorithm and the 38-marble pouch.

nodes.name: Sports Tracker

nodes.name: Keysmith

nodes.name: ScreenHop

nodes.name: Trackpad

nodes.name: OmaSpotify
nodes.author: jeremylanger
nodes.description: Spotify in Quickshell with all the features you need—using about 60 MB of memory versus roughly 950 MB for the official client.

nodes.name: Capture

nodes.description: Clipboard-aware quick capture into an Obsidian vault — one analysis-ready note per capture, with YAML frontmatter and a reused tag vocabulary

nodes.description: Battery level of each half of a ZMK split keyboard in the Omarchy bar, with a shortcut to ZMK Studio. The peripheral (right) half's level needs CONFIG_ZMK_SPLIT_BLE_CENTRAL_BATTERY_LEVEL_FETCHING=y and CONFIG_ZMK_SPLIT_BLE_CENTRAL_BATTERY_LEVEL_PROXY=y in your ZMK config.

nodes.name: Studio Display Auto Brightness

nodes.name: Steam progress

nodes.name: Activity Monitor

nodes.description: A system activity monitor for the Omarchy bar: live CPU, GPU, memory, temperature, and fan telemetry with rolling history graphs and ranked process lists — so the next time your machine starts sweating, you'll know exactly who's making it run.

nodes.name: Easy Capture

nodes.description: Headset battery in the bar: level, charge state and connection for every wireless or USB headset UPower knows about, with low battery, fully charged and disconnect notifications. No helper process and no daemon.

nodes.name: Omastart

nodes.description: Choose which installed applications start automatically when you log in to Omarchy.

nodes.name: Keyboard Nightlight Sync
nodes.author: grnqrtr

A hue/saturation picker with the active theme's own palette as presets, an opacity slider, a transparency switch, and bar text that keeps itself readable against whatever you pick. The choice is written to ~/.config/omarchy/shell.toml, so it applies live and survives theme switches and updates.

nodes.name: Omarchy RDP Monitor

nodes.description: Shows when someone is controlling this machine over Remote Desktop Protocol, and notifies on connect

nodes.description: Choose which browser runs Omarchy webapps, independently of your system default, with per-app overrides and a Firefox/Zen launch adapter. Survives Omarchy updates.

nodes.name: Keybindings Visualizer
nodes.author: Ming Bao
nodes.description: Visual on-screen-keyboard view of your Hyprland keybindings, grouped by modifier layer.

nodes.name: Bookflow

nodes.description: Reading tracker for the Omarchy bar. Captures the last page read from your document viewer, shows what is left of the current book, and estimates the sessions and days to finish it.

nodes.name: TickTick Tasks
nodes.author: Aeolus
nodes.description: Today and overdue TickTick tasks in the Omarchy bar.

nodes.description: Now-playing album art in the bar, with a panel for pause, skip back, and skip forward

nodes.author: Mohamad Jahani
nodes.description: Arzdoon shows live Iranian rial buy and sell rates in the Omarchy bar. Left-click the $ item for a compact table; use Show in Bar to pin selected sell prices on the bar itself. Middle-click or press R to refresh. If the source is unreachable, the last successful snapshot stays on screen. Settings pick the provider, refresh interval, and how many rates can appear in the bar.

nodes.name: Next Theme
nodes.author: Chyld Medford
nodes.description: Omarchy ships a long list of themes, and names like Miasma, Lumon and Ristretto tell you nothing about how they look. Next Theme puts a contrast circle in your bar: click it for a popup with Previous and Next, or just scroll the icon. Every step applies the real theme to your whole desktop, and the popup stays open and re-colours itself as you browse. It steps in order and never shuffles, so you can walk back to the one you just passed and a single pass shows you every theme exactly once.

nodes.name: OmaTempo
nodes.author: Mutahir
nodes.description: Your Omarchy installation duration, machine and phase breakdown in a theme-aware badge.

nodes.name: Claude effort

nodes.description: Steers Claude Code's effort level from the Claude session usage that the Agents panel collects.

nodes.name: Camera Test

nodes.description: Preview and verify any connected camera directly from the Omarchy bar.

nodes.name: Apex Keyboard
nodes.author: davidzu
nodes.description: Control SteelSeries Apex 7 TKL RGB, OLED, and the scroll wheel from the Omarchy bar.

nodes.name: TouchFlow
nodes.author: nagual
nodes.description: Four-finger touchpad gestures as one IPC plugin: move/maximize the active window, jump between occupied workspaces skipping empty holes, and fall back to the app menu or a terminal.

nodes.description: One tiny corner button: left-click toggles float/tiling, right-click closes, 3-finger tap drags the window. Plus hover-revealed edge buttons on tiled windows that move the tile in that direction (SUPER+SHIFT+arrow behavior).

nodes.name: Plugin Doctor

nodes.description: Read-only manifest health checks for installed Omarchy plugins.

nodes.name: Things
nodes.author: Marius Ghizdavet
nodes.description: Things 3 in the Omarchy bar: all seven views (Today, Upcoming, Anytime, Someday, Inbox, Projects, Logbook) plus search, with quick-add, scheduling, moving and checklists — backed by the things3 Cloud CLI. Speaks 10 languages, following the system locale by default.

nodes.name: Browser Settings

All over D-Bus to openrazer-daemon; no network access.

nodes.name: Sydney Train Planner

nodes.name: Netspeed

nodes.name: Omalang

It can also open apps, pages and bookmarks, switch workspaces, change the theme, set volume and brightness and control what is playing, each one opt-in. The agent is never granted a shell or a tool. Arm it from the bar.

nodes.name: Panorama

nodes.description: Display settings for Hyprland: arrange monitors, resolution, scaling, HDR, VRR, brightness, profiles

nodes.name: Music Touchbar

nodes.name: Omarchy Chime

nodes.name: Feedback

nodes.description: Report a bug or idea about anything on your Omarchy desktop in one keypress. Passwords and keys are masked before anything is saved. Local issue list and web viewer with PDF and Markdown export.

nodes.name: Omawin
nodes.author: Diogo Chaves
nodes.description: Microsoft Windows 11 from the bar: start, connect to, pause and stop Omarchy's Windows VM (virtual machine, RDP) in one click, tune its cores, RAM and disk, and keep its login. No terminal, no docker group.

nodes.name: UniFi Network

nodes.name: Omalogi
nodes.author: elberacasa
nodes.description: Onboard profiles for Logitech G-series mice.

nodes.description: All drives in the Omarchy bar: a single icon opens a popup with every disk, mounted or not — click unmounted to mount, click mounted to open, press 't' to open in terminal, click ✕ button to unmount, ⏏ to eject (power-off) removable drives.

nodes.name: Package Store

nodes.name: Switcher

nodes.name: Thermals & Fans

nodes.name: Omarchy Top Bar Peek

Run this plugin's install.sh (see its README) after every install, enable, AND update — `omarchy plugin update` alone does not rebuild or reinstall the privileged daemon.

nodes.name: Readout

nodes.name: Expanding Top Bar

nodes.name: Multi-monitor Workspaces Indicator

nodes.description: Per-monitor workspace indicators with a distinct global focus marker

nodes.name: Temperature Monitor
nodes.author: Ranger McTague & opencode

nodes.name: Rotate

nodes.name: GitHub Repo Tracker

nodes.description: Tracks GitHub release download totals for your own and third-party repos, with weekly sparklines, trend-colored lines and a normalized compare view. Repos are split into 'mine' and 'others' categories, cached per-repo to JSON and refreshed weekly from the GitHub API.

nodes.name: OMedia Controls

nodes.name: Muster

nodes.name: Coolwatch

Cloud or self-hosted, several instances at once, REST API only: no daemon, no SSH, nothing to babysit.

nodes.name: Apple Music · Afterglow

nodes.description: An immersive Apple Music listening room for Omarchy

nodes.name: Google Calendar
nodes.author: Shivam Mathur
nodes.description: Multi-account Google Calendar and Tasks for the Omarchy bar

nodes.name: Banatik

WAN link and public IP, RouterOS version and pending firmware, CPU and memory, Wi-Fi clients with signal, DHCP devices, ZeroTier and WireGuard / Back To Home peers, logins, firewall counters, traffic charts up to 30 days and the router log, read over REST with a read-only user and a pinned certificate. Alerts when the internet link drops, the public IP changes, a new device joins or someone logs into the router.

nodes.name: Servings

nodes.name: Sudo Watch

nodes.name: Shader Wallpaper

nodes.name: Keybind Dojo

nodes.name: Crash Desk
nodes.author: Carlos Granier
nodes.description: A history of what crashed on this machine, grouped by program, with one-key AI diagnosis. The crash toast tells you once; Crash Desk remembers.

nodes.name: Theme Clock
nodes.author: Carlos Granier
nodes.description: Switches your Omarchy theme at sunrise and sunset, or at times you pick, and leaves it alone when you change it yourself.

nodes.name: PredatorSense PH315-52

nodes.name: Torrents

nodes.description: Monitor and control multiple torrent clients (Transmission, qBittorrent & Deluge) from the bar.

nodes.name: Octopus Energy

nodes.name: Omabeam
nodes.author: Gabbe2312
nodes.description: Lightbeam for the whole machine. A living graph of every process with a socket open and every remote host on the far end of one, plus every service that has your e-mail address, read from the mailbox itself.

nodes.name: OmaGAWD
nodes.author: David
nodes.description: Winamp soul. Omarchy fit. Badass llama dance moves. Jellyfin, local music and worldwide radio in a compact player that follows your theme. Real frequency spectrum, keyboard control, saved playlists and update notices. Discover stations by name, genre, country or language; save favourites or add a stream link. Tab and arrows browse; Return plays; Alt+Return adds. The player llama rotates through running man, side shuffle, head banging and twerk; the bar icon stays still.

nodes.name: Cursor Accent
nodes.author: Jean Alvarado
nodes.description: Recolors the system cursor to the active Omarchy theme's accent, with a fixed-color or system-default option and a choice of pointer shape.

nodes.name: Astro-Arc

nodes.name: Omarchy Friends

nodes.name: Local Web Services

nodes.name: Theme RGB

nodes.name: Super Plugin Search
nodes.author: Oliver Lukschander
nodes.description: Search the Omarchy plugin marketplace from the super-menu.

nodes.name: Omarchy Statusline
nodes.author: lucas
nodes.description: CPU, memory, GPU, disk and temperature at a glance, with live history and Omarchy theme integration.

nodes.name: AgentCron

nodes.name: Gap Resize
nodes.author: EURYMEDON INTERACTIVE
nodes.description: Resize tiled windows by dragging the shared gap between them with a native resize cursor and visual guide rail.

nodes.name: Clock (French)

nodes.name: Omagic
nodes.author: ben
nodes.description: Apple Magic Keyboard and Trackpad: Bluetooth, battery, function keys, and Hyprland trackpad settings.

nodes.name: Omafan
nodes.author: heroesofcode
nodes.description: Temperature-driven fan control for Apple hardware running Linux, from the Omarchy bar. Omafan raises the fan's floor as the machine heats up, and shows the temperature in the bar.

nodes.name: Adaptive Brightness

nodes.name: RPN Calculator

nodes.name: iStats
nodes.author: dbachelder
nodes.description: iStat Menus-style system monitor: network throughput, CPU, GPU, memory and storage in one bar entry. Each reading is its own click target, and the dropdown opens focused on the domain you clicked.

nodes.name: Network

nodes.description: Wi-Fi network controls with camera QR joining and a password visibility toggle.

nodes.name: Scroll edges

nodes.name: Super Player

nodes.name: App Dock

nodes.description: True minimize/restore for Hyprland 0.56 (which has none): one icon per window in the bar, click to minimize/restore, per-workspace docks, optional titlebar buttons. Layer with Floating Window Mode and Window Switcher for the full desktop experience.

nodes.name: Charge Mode
nodes.author: Lucas Videla
nodes.description: Charge-limit control for the Omarchy bar: 60% on the desk (To Stay) or a full 100% for travel (On Go). Works with the standard kernel charge threshold and Lenovo IdeaPad conservation mode.

nodes.name: Hyprworld
nodes.author: Tristan Demers
nodes.description: A two-dimensional scrolling workspace for Hyprland on Omarchy, with visible window groups, searchable overview, smooth-fit minimap, continuous cross-monitor drag outlines, shared workspaces, placement paths, startup templates, and keyboard/touchpad controls. Settled checkpoints restore layouts after plugin resets in the same compositor session. Requires the Hyprland Lua API, Omarchy Shell, and a native helper built for the running Hyprland version.

nodes.name: Mouse jiggler
nodes.author: Youhan Wu
nodes.description: Click-to-toggle Omarchy bar mouse jiggler. Nudges the Hyprland pointer so idle lock, screensaver, and apps stay awake.

nodes.name: Screen Time
nodes.author: nabdalla
nodes.description: Daily screen time per app in your Omarchy bar: sees what runs inside terminals, names Steam games, folds browsers and web apps. The popup has a donut chart, a 52-week trend, insights, a yearly overview that reaches back to your first day, a daily goal, a settings menu and an optional faint background picture. Fully local: nothing leaves your machine.

nodes.name: Lanes
nodes.author: David Bradley
nodes.description: A workspace-first taskbar for the Omarchy shell with live agent status, minimize, a top-bar widget, and a top-edge shade for calendar, clock, media, weather, and radar.

nodes.name: Alienware Battery
nodes.author: xyzlab
nodes.description: A battery indicator for the Omarchy bar without the power-profiles picker, so it does not fight Alienware thermal profiles. Shows charge, rate, time left, size and cycles, switches thermal profiles through alienwarectl, and can drop the panel refresh rate and the thermal profile when you unplug.

nodes.name: Terror Zone

nodes.author: Mindful Stack

Jump by number or arrow, drag windows between workspaces, type to find one, open the scratchpad, or arm a workspace so its windows go black in every screen share. A bar button beside your workspaces. Theme-aware; nothing runs until you summon it.

nodes.author: Scott Angel

Blackdrop covers the bar and inhibits idle, so the display and its audio stay alive; silence becomes OLED-friendly true black with a drifting neon Omarchy mark. Installed from the marketplace it shows a setup card that finishes the one-time projectM packages and its reversible configuration in one visible step.

nodes.name: Elevenmates

nodes.name: App Grid

nodes.name: OmaSnippet

nodes.description: Type saved text with customizable keyboard shortcuts and a retro terminal editor.

nodes.name: Voicebind
nodes.author: Kane Snyder
nodes.description: Natural voice control for Omarchy with Jev AI and local Whisper. Say ‘computer’ or hold F10 to open apps, move windows, chain commands, dictate text and recall saved workspace layouts. Personalise phrases and app aliases in bar settings, with a waveform that follows your theme. Jev interprets more flexible command phrasing; it is optional and uses your own API key.

nodes.name: Hyperwyrm
nodes.author: dawestheperson
nodes.description: A pixel-art eastern dragon pet driven by a tiny CfC neural network. It lives in your bar, roams your windows, grows through four stages, learns your habits, and becomes one of five final dragons depending on how you raised it.

nodes.name: Midnight Royale

nodes.name: Storage Drives

nodes.name: Omarchy-coros

nodes.name: Doubao Say

nodes.name: Omarchy Super Switcher

nodes.name: Battery

nodes.name: Local AI Dashboard

Start and stop the systemd background service, view available models with current model status, monitor CPU/GPU/DRAM/VRAM usage, with quick access to view debug output via a new terminal session, and one click open your config files via nvim.

nodes.name: Mini-Bar

nodes.name: ZmanBar

Your password stays on Proton's sign-in page. Pause, resume, and keep both conflict copies from the chip. Deletes go to recycle or Trash, and a large change waits for you.

nodes.name: Tailfin
nodes.author: Greg DeYoung
nodes.description: Tailscale panel with tabbed layout: connection health, preference toggles, exit nodes with suggestions, Mullvad regions, and a searchable machine list. Forked from Omarchy's first-party omarchy.tailscale (MIT).

nodes.name: Dynamic Island
nodes.author: lunanoir21
nodes.description: A Dynamic Island-style widget for Hyprland — media, calls, notifications, timers and a pixel clock in one pill that expands from the top of the screen.

nodes.name: Flight Board

nodes.description: A split-flap screensaver with live Norwegian flights, optional 30-second turning, and screensaver, lock and display-off controls in one place.

nodes.name: NotebookLM Bridge
nodes.author: stefanbringuier
nodes.description: Add sources to and ask questions of NotebookLM from Omarchy.

nodes.name: Omarchy RGB Sync
nodes.author: fewhnhouse

nodes.author: CopinHeart
nodes.description: Wallpapers with video. Every applied wallpaper (videos, images and GIFs) is saved to ~/Videos/Wallpapers for easy cleanup.

nodes.name: Steam Launcher

One click launches a game. Right-click still gives Steam's own native menu (Store, Library, Friends, Settings, Exit).

nodes.author: Alan
nodes.description: Camera snapshot pill in the bar, with a popup camera switcher, live preview, and a one-click live-view launch via mpv. Talks to a local go2rtc instance, never to any camera's own protocol directly, so it works with anything go2rtc supports (Reolink, ONVIF, Nest, Ring, TP-Link, Doorbird, Wyze, and more). Add, edit, remove, and switch between cameras right from the popup — nothing to pre-configure, works with a fresh go2rtc install with zero cameras defined.

Live at-socket watts on the bar, and a panel with energy and cost per day, week, month and year, kept permanently from the day you install it. CPU energy comes from RAPL hardware counters and GPU power from amdgpu (AMD) or NVML (NVIDIA); the rest of the machine is a calibratable estimate, and the share of every reading that is actually measured is always on screen.

nodes.name: Omadocked

nodes.name: Omarchy Replay

nodes.name: Superstrike

nodes.name: Ampbar for Plex
nodes.author: kyllan
nodes.description: An independent Omarchy bar player for your personal Plex music library, with playback controls, waveform seeking, and library browsing.

nodes.name: UniCast
nodes.author: liberuum
nodes.description: Discover any Wi-Fi TV or receiver and cast local media (or the file your player is playing) to it over DLNA, Google Cast, or AirPlay, with volume, audio boost and subtitles.

nodes.name: Omarchy Dock
nodes.author: Bence Szluka
nodes.description: macOS-style dock for Omarchy: window previews, real minimize, drag-to-workspace and USB drives, drawn with the shell's own design tokens.

nodes.name: Bluesky composer
nodes.author: thenitai
nodes.description: Post to Bluesky from anywhere — text, screenshots and clipboard images from the bar or a global shortcut

nodes.name: Interval
nodes.author: joe93
nodes.description: Interval timer for training sessions. Set the total training time, the exercise name, and the work/rest intervals; run shows a big countdown right in the bar. Pin it to the screen and a large always-on-top view keeps the time visible while you train, toggled with a click.

nodes.name: Astro A50
nodes.author: leonavas
nodes.description: The Astro A50 headset (Gen 4 and Gen 5) in the bar: battery with low-battery alerts, equalizer, mic level, sidetone, noise gate and game/voice mix, without Windows.

nodes.name: Foamy Lock
nodes.author: foamrider
nodes.description: An Omarchy lock screen with account details, clock, media controls, and password or fingerprint authentication.

nodes.name: Foamy GitHub
nodes.author: foamrider
nodes.description: Local Git repository status with per-repository actions.

nodes.name: Foamy Weather
nodes.author: foamrider
nodes.description: MET Norway weather with dynamic location and a three-day forecast

nodes.name: Citadel
nodes.author: Neat Ouk
nodes.description: An outbound firewall in your bar. When an app connects somewhere new, it waits at the gate: see the app, who started it, its integrity, host, country and port, then Block, Allow once or Always allow. Policies per app, zones per network, threat feeds and AdGuard/Pi-hole imports, per-app proxy routing, live traffic and history. Watching works on its own; to block, install citadel-helper (github.com/NeatOuk/citadel-helper), a small root package that applies your policies with nftables.

nodes.name: TekVoice
nodes.author: TierTek
nodes.description: A live voice changer on a virtual microphone. Pick a voice in the bar and every app - Zoom, Discord, Meet, OBS - hears it. Switching voices never drops the mic, and a panic key brings your real voice straight back.

nodes.name: Foamy Notification Center
nodes.author: foamrider
nodes.description: Notification history with app stacks, search, and do not disturb

nodes.name: Foamy Syncthing
nodes.author: foamrider
nodes.description: A Syncthing plugin with a bundled native core for monitoring file activity, safely managing folders, controlling the user service, and following the Omarchy theme.

nodes.name: Hymos
nodes.author: diogocezar
nodes.description: Smooth, eased scrolling for your mouse wheel in every app on Hyprland, like Mos on macOS. Turn it on and tune how far and how long each scroll glides from one icon in the Omarchy bar.

nodes.name: OmaKeybinds
nodes.author: OddlyCrusty
nodes.description: Browse, compare, add, and safely edit Omarchy keyboard shortcuts.

nodes.name: OmaPandora
nodes.author: Dankestrick
nodes.description: Pandora for the Omarchy bar: a mini player and full player that play through Pithos and follow your theme.

nodes.name: Bluetooth Status
nodes.author: redeye1011
nodes.description: One bar slot showing speaker, earbuds, mouse, and keyboard Bluetooth connection status, each independently hideable

nodes.name: WireGuard
nodes.author: Jon
nodes.description: Your VPN, on when you leave home: WireGuard that connects itself on Wi-Fi you don't trust and stays off on the ones you do.

nodes.name: NextDNS
nodes.author: Jon
nodes.description: NextDNS that never strands you: filtering at a glance, and hotel or café Wi-Fi that just works, switching back when it can.

nodes.name: Foamy Clock
nodes.author: foamrider
nodes.description: Configurable clock, calendar and local Evolution agenda

nodes.name: Island
nodes.author: guilhermerisu
nodes.description: A floating, morphing Omarchy bar

nodes.name: OSKar
nodes.author: vladkarok
nodes.description: OSKar — mouse-driven on-screen keyboard that follows the active keyboard layout, types through a persistent virtual keyboard, and matches the Omarchy theme. Toggle with the bar icon or: omarchy-shell shell toggle io.github.vladkarok.oskar

nodes.name: Gona Launcher
nodes.author: mglq
nodes.description: Highly configurable app launcher: tiles you split, colour and arrange yourself, one tap of Super away

nodes.name: UniFi

nodes.description: UniFi network health in the Omarchy bar: internet, this device's Wi-Fi, UniFi devices, and connected clients.

nodes.name: Trolley

nodes.description: Play Trolley with GitHub login and live Elo and global rank in the bar

nodes.name: Bar Hide
nodes.author: wynout
nodes.description: Hide the Omarchy top bar on selected monitors. Pin the native bar to one screen or several in a multi-monitor setup; unselected screens get no bar. Per-screen live control from the bar tray.

nodes.name: Resonance
nodes.author: mystaryo
nodes.description: Live cava spectrum with 18 selectable visual styles in the bar. Click for Now Playing (any MPRIS player, cover art, transport), a cliamp radio tab, and settings.

nodes.name: Flare
nodes.author: lunanoir21
nodes.description: AI usage notch for Omarchy — Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Cursor, Antigravity and Kiro limits and sessions in one edge-mounted notch.

nodes.name: Minimized windows
nodes.author: brightwalker25
nodes.description: Shelf of minimized windows; icon only until hovered

nodes.name: Net Speed Colour
nodes.author: brightwalker25
nodes.description: Live upload and download on the physical network link, with the VPN tunnel and daily usage in a panel

nodes.name: Screensaver
nodes.author: Brian Ehlers
nodes.description: Turn the screensaver on or off, set wait time, and pause it while video plays

nodes.name: MEGA Sync
nodes.author: Vitor Pacheco
nodes.description: MEGA storage, transfers and folder syncs in the Omarchy bar, powered by MEGAcmd.

nodes.name: Jira Search
nodes.author: Aurelien Navarre
nodes.description: Search Jira by text, JQL or ticket ID in a centered search window, and view an issue's metadata.

nodes.name: Agent Usage
nodes.author: RektyRowdyy
nodes.description: The Omarchy Agents widget with a toggleable inline view: left-click to show your default agent's session and weekly usage right in the bar.

nodes.name: Mod3 Solitaire
nodes.author: jsauer
nodes.description: Launch and toggle the Mod3 Solitaire game on a special (scratchpad) workspace, like a dropdown window.

nodes.name: Proton Authenticator
nodes.author: Zeus-Deus
nodes.description: Proton Authenticator 2FA codes in the Omarchy bar: type to search, Enter to copy, synced with your phone through Proton's own app.

nodes.name: YouTube Downloader
nodes.author: Minhaj Shafin
nodes.description: Download audio and video from YouTube using yt-dlp

nodes.name: NetScope
nodes.author: frig
nodes.description: LAN reconnaissance for Omarchy: local IPs per interface, public IP, Wi-Fi and IPv6 context, and every device on the network with its vendor and guessed type. Probe any host's TCP ports, get a security-posture score, and run an AI investigation of a device or the whole network. Continuous monitoring names devices and alerts on new arrivals; export reports and drive it from a bar widget, a window, or a terminal UI. Developed for and by frig.

nodes.name: Lanchat
nodes.author: KelpME
nodes.description: Encrypted, friend-gated chat for your LAN. Your machines find each other automatically — TLS with cert-fingerprint identity, approved-friends handshake, group rooms, undoable sends, and LocalSend-style file attachments.

nodes.name: Postcard
nodes.author: tahayvr
nodes.description: Turn a screenshot or a piece of code into something worth posting: padding, backgrounds, rounded corners, shadows, syntax highlighting, annotations and one-click redaction.

nodes.name: OmanewsNC
nodes.author: clartek
nodes.description: Nextcloud News RSS reader for the Omarchy status bar. Direct browser login, sliding reader view, offline reading, live unread counter, and podcast player.

nodes.name: Audiobookshelf for Omarchy
nodes.author: Jason Carrasco
nodes.description: A full Audiobookshelf client for the Omarchy bar — books and podcasts, resume position, chapters, per-item speed, and background new-episode notifications.

nodes.name: Keyboard
nodes.author: Brian Ehlers
nodes.description: Keyboard backlight color, brightness, and effects for the Sager P870DM-G

nodes.name: Fans
nodes.author: Brian Ehlers
nodes.description: Fan curve, cool and quiet, and performance mode for the Sager P870DM-G

nodes.name: FreshRSS for Omarchy
nodes.author: Jason Carrasco
nodes.description: FreshRSS client for the Omarchy bar: unread count, categories and articles in a themed dropdown, read/star state synced with your FreshRSS server.

nodes.name: Logomarchy
nodes.author: Payton Biddington
nodes.description: For theme hoppers who want to always be repping Omarchy on their desktop. Every theme gets a matching logo wallpaper in three sizes, with a handful of theme colors to play with.

nodes.name: Breathwork
nodes.author: Roland Jo
nodes.description: A customizable guided-breathing pacer for Omarchy with built-in and named personal protocols, session tracking, and a daily streak.

nodes.name: Dock
nodes.author: leonavas
nodes.description: Icons for the windows open in the current workspace, in the same order they sit on screen, in the center of the bar.

nodes.name: Miniflux
nodes.author: Aurelien Navarre
nodes.description: Read the latest unread items from a Miniflux instance and mark them read without leaving the bar.

nodes.name: My Dock
nodes.author: stash-11
nodes.description: A theme-aware macOS-inspired Omarchy dock with magnification, auto-hide, pinning, app switching, and adjustable appearance.

nodes.name: OmaWidgets
nodes.author: Fabricio Oliveira de Andrade
nodes.description: Desktop widget cards for Omarchy, in the spirit of the macOS desktop: CPU, memory and GPU load and temperature, now playing with transport controls, a to-do list with a Pomodoro timer, AirPods battery, battery status, and a one-click power profile switch. Drag them into place, and switch to compact rounded tiles. Themed entirely from the active Omarchy theme.

nodes.name: omaLens
nodes.author: jgarza
nodes.description: A live magnifying glass that floats beside the pointer, with a settings window for zoom, size, shape, and key bindings.

nodes.name: Mullvad Orb
nodes.author: vonsensey
nodes.description: Mullvad VPN on a spinning globe. Pick a server by clicking a dot or searching country, city and server; the orb flies there and draws your tunnel. Nearly every Mullvad setting in one panel: multihop, DAITA, quantum-resistant tunnels, lockdown, DNS content blockers, anti-censorship, custom lists, split tunneling, API access, devices and account. Themed from your Omarchy colors. Unofficial; not affiliated with Mullvad VPN AB.

nodes.name: Jev emoji
nodes.author: nun
nodes.description: Type words. Jev scores every emoji and shows the best matches first.

nodes.name: Cisco VPN
nodes.author: Jeffe747
nodes.description: Connect to a Cisco AnyConnect VPN through NetworkManager and OpenConnect.

nodes.name: Information Wallpaper Overlay
nodes.author: Adrian Wild
nodes.description: Information on your wallpaper: up to six tiles behind your windows, laid out the way Hyprland tiles windows. GitHub repos with a year of commits and live Actions runs; herdr's coding agents, working or waiting for you; builds, flashing and updates, passed or failed; what's playing; or any installed plugin's menu, shown live. Follows your theme, gaps and rounding, never takes a click, uses your gh login, and can fill the lock screen too.

nodes.name: ProCyclingStats
nodes.author: vip32
nodes.description: Professional road cycling races and live race situation.

nodes.name: huSSH
nodes.author: Wizard-NetEng
nodes.description: A compact SSH client in the bar: grouped session list imported from SecureCRT or PuTTY, live reachability dots, and one-click connect in your default terminal. TACACS credentials are held in the kernel keyring for a limited window, never written to disk.

nodes.name: Brand Effects
nodes.author: callmeATHUL
nodes.description: Animated bar wordmark: a rotating set of terminal-effect motions masked to your own art and tinted by the theme. Opens the Omarchy menu on click.

nodes.name: Agent Monitor
nodes.author: RohiRIK
nodes.description: AI coding agent dashboard: subscription limits, daily activity, and model usage for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Hermes, pi, OpenRouter, and more.

nodes.name: Omanote
nodes.author: iluxav
nodes.description: Obsidian-style markdown notes in your terminal: live preview, tables, images and GitHub-synced vaults. Find, start or jot a note straight from the bar.

nodes.name: Omarchy KVM Manager
nodes.author: tug-benson
nodes.description: KVM/QEMU VM manager for Omarchy — list libvirt domains, start/shutdown/reboot/suspend/resume, console via virt-viewer, snapshots & default NAT network, live polling.

nodes.name: Power Managment
nodes.author: tug-benson
nodes.description: Power & idle manager — screensaver, display-off, auto-lock, AC/battery suspend and lid-switch from the bar. Edits hypridle + logind drop-in via pkexec, auto-hides battery/lid on desktop.

nodes.name: Kanji Lookup
nodes.author: Expri
nodes.description: Japanese dictionary lookup in the bar: search JMdict/KANJIDIC2 offline, capture kanji from the screen via OCR

nodes.name: Liquid Glass
nodes.author: fasi96
nodes.description: Apple-style Liquid Glass for your terminals: thick glass edges that bend what's behind them and catch the light as you move, a slow oil film, and Glass Tuner to adjust all of it live. The bar button sets it up on first click (it builds a Hyprland plugin with hyprpm, so it asks for your password), then opens the tuner. To remove it, run ~/.local/share/omarchy-liquid-glass/uninstall.sh before omarchy plugin remove.

nodes.name: Remote Desktop
nodes.author: ylaung-uod
nodes.description: RDP status and controls for the current Omarchy Hyprland session, with reboot-safe in-memory credentials.

nodes.name: SoundCloud
nodes.author: Bruno Silveira
nodes.description: SoundCloud playback and account controls in the Omarchy bar

nodes.name: Jumpy
nodes.author: Gran Software Solutions
nodes.description: Alt+Tab for Omarchy: tap to flip back, hold to see every window, type to find one.

nodes.name: OmaJump
nodes.author: belogermanotta
nodes.description: Navigate, search, scroll, and copy text across every screen

nodes.name: Glass
nodes.author: Gordon Wan
nodes.description: Milky-glass control panel for the omarchy bar: frosted window opacity, compositor blur, rounding, and dim — 10 styles (9 looks + Stock), sync-all, style tour, undo — live-apply while dragging.

nodes.name: OMyPhone
nodes.author: Boyidzham
nodes.description: Make and take phone calls from the desktop through your Bluetooth-paired phone

nodes.name: Opal
nodes.author: Derek Ross
nodes.description: Nostr in your Omarchy bar: a NIP-46 signer (bunker) that keeps your nsec in the keyring, notifications (replies, mentions, zaps, DMs), and NIP-38 now-playing and status. Needs the opald daemon: run dist/install.sh.

nodes.name: Geo Guess
nodes.author: LessUnderRated
nodes.description: Street View explorer and geolocation game. A Chromium extension can hide Maps chrome during a round; no API keys.

nodes.name: Lock Keys OSD
nodes.author: trinity-bytes
nodes.description: Shows the Omarchy OSD when Caps Lock or Num Lock changes state.

nodes.name: Launch & Bind
nodes.author: Uwe Bruckhaus
nodes.description: Fast, theme-aware app launcher for Omarchy: type to find any app, give it or its actions (e.g. New Incognito Window) a global shortcut, and open widgets, plugins and tray apps from a second list, where widgets can also be put into or taken out of the bar. See who owns every key, rebind it in one click, or use two-step shortcuts.

nodes.name: Jev Challenge Lab
nodes.author: edddine4-source
nodes.description: Build, run, and save structured TypeSafe Jev challenges inside an Omarchy bar panel.

nodes.name: GitHub Notifications
nodes.author: Matteo Rosati
nodes.description: Unread GitHub notifications in the Omarchy bar. The GitHub mark is lit while `gh api notifications` has something for you and dimmed when the inbox is quiet; clicking it lists every notification with separate links to the repository and to the subject.

nodes.name: Echocast
nodes.author: hexploder
nodes.description: Redirect one machine's audio to another machine's speakers over SSH — on/off and a device picker on the server, on/off on the client — with automatic local fallback the moment that's not possible.

nodes.name: Auto Performance
nodes.author: Michael Munson
nodes.description: Switches to the performance power profile when CPU load spikes, and back down once things go quiet.

nodes.name: Tray Panel
nodes.author: omakits-x
nodes.description: System tray icons on the bar with a Windows-style overflow panel for hidden ones.

nodes.name: omaudiopanel
nodes.author: thevideinfra
nodes.description: Omarchy's audio panel plus device disabling, per-app output routing and pinning, tab titles and an adjustable volume step

nodes.name: DR Lyd
nodes.author: Martin
nodes.description: Play DR (Danish national radio) live: P1-P8, regional P4/P5 and LYD ekstra, straight from the bar.

nodes.name: Power Menu
nodes.author: BlackCode
nodes.description: Bar power button with lock, logout, suspend, hibernate, reboot, and shutdown

nodes.name: ASCII Wallpaper
nodes.author: betim
nodes.description: Convert any video into an ASCII-art wallpaper tinted to your current Omarchy theme. Adds 'Style > ASCII Wallpaper' to the menu.

nodes.name: Signal Messenger
nodes.author: iamteedoh
nodes.description: Signal messenger: terminal client, popup notifications you can answer in place, and a bar widget with unread count

nodes.name: Windows VM Manager
nodes.author: Yanuar Pambudi
nodes.description: Native Quickshell bar widget and control panel for Omarchy Windows VM

nodes.name: GlobalConnect
nodes.author: martin76ec
nodes.description: VPN status and controls for the Omarchy bar.

nodes.name: omadroidctrl
nodes.author: Toby Stevenson
nodes.description: Pair your Android phone with a QR code and mirror it with scrcpy, over Wi-Fi or your tailnet, from the bar.

nodes.name: Sidecar for M1-M2 - leoaba
nodes.author: Leo Aba
nodes.description: iPad as a second display for M1/M2 MacBooks on Omarchy, which cannot drive an external monitor under Asahi. Wi-Fi or USB-C, touch input, via the free OpenDisplay iPad app.

nodes.name: Title Bars
nodes.author: marcho78
nodes.description: Window title bars with minimize, maximize, and close buttons that follow your Omarchy theme. A settings panel with live preview lets you restyle the buttons, move them left or right, change or hide the title, pick custom colors, and reset to the default look. Built on hyprbars from hyprwm/hyprland-plugins.

nodes.name: Audiogram EQ
nodes.author: Fail-Safe
nodes.description: Listener-compensating equalizer. Ships blank (0 dB HL); enter clinical audiogram thresholds in the panel. Headphones/speakers presets and optional per-ear L/R gains.

nodes.name: HovenCast
nodes.author: Sean Hovenkamp
nodes.description: Extend Omarchy with a dedicated workspace or share a desktop, window, or selected area with compatible Roku TVs.

nodes.name: IP config
nodes.author: fivefold3
nodes.description: Toggle network adapters and switch them between DHCP and a static IP

nodes.name: Wisp
nodes.author: Wisp contributors
nodes.description: Voice-first presence and hangouts for a small circle of friends.

nodes.name: Omodachi
nodes.author: Leo Zhang
nodes.description: Use your iPhone or iPad with this Omarchy desktop. Remote makes it an extra screen or hands it the whole desktop to drive by touch, over Sunshine or, failing that, WayVNC. The app also runs the Omarchy menu and keybindings, talks to your coding agent, shows herdr panes and desktop notifications, and opens an SSH terminal. This plugin adds the bar icon and panel, pairs a device with one Approve and installs the open-source host daemon. Guide and app: omodachi.app

nodes.name: Mini Cider
nodes.author: pwnsxb
nodes.description: Mini reproductor flotante para Cider 2

nodes.name: Jezz Atelier
nodes.author: Julian Bruno
nodes.description: An offline single-player JezzBall-inspired game: cut around bouncing spheres to reveal public-domain paintings

nodes.name: Skinamp
nodes.author: idrewlong
nodes.description: The Spotify player you can skin. A music icon in the bar with a rich mini player on hover (cover, live spectrum, the current lyric line, seek, transport, like, volume); click it for the full player with eleven looks, from today's Spotify app to Winamp, iPod and Windows Media Player, plus real visualizers.

nodes.name: Clock + Timer
nodes.author: ACooperDev
nodes.description: Date/time label with a calendar popup, plus a countdown timer and stopwatch

nodes.name: Jimaku
nodes.author: agata
nodes.description: Live translated subtitles for app audio, in a separate resizable window.

nodes.name: Spotify Wave
nodes.author: naimhasim
nodes.description: 10-band EQ + desktop music visualizer for Spotify: one filter-chain sink feeds both the equalizer and the cava spectrum strip

nodes.name: Omarchy Tablet
nodes.author: Charles Rivest
nodes.description: Switch Omarchy between tablet and desktop modes, with a touch launcher, single-app layout, on-screen keyboard and dictation shortcuts.

nodes.name: Endurance
nodes.author: Freeholder
nodes.description: Battery sessions, real-world endurance history, and experimental process activity in the Omarchy bar.

nodes.name: Iris
nodes.author: Tirthankar Bhattacharjee
nodes.description: A fast, elegant, keyboard-driven universal search overlay and quick launcher for Omarchy Quattro with Quickshell and Hyprland.

nodes.name: Pointer & Scroll
nodes.author: Angus Forbes
nodes.description: Touchpad pointer and scroll acceleration for Omarchy: slow finger = precise, fast flick = far, with a live curve graph.

nodes.name: Omarchy-AI
nodes.author: Omri Ben Ami
nodes.description: Self-hosted agentic voice assistant for the Omarchy desktop. Wake word, whole-machine tools, Task Runtime, phone and TV. This marketplace entry is the settings panel. Install the full assistant first; the widget alone does not run the daemon.

nodes.name: MIB Network Profiles
nodes.author: Min Kim
nodes.description: Network profiles like macOS Locations: named sets of IP, DNS, IPv6, Wi-Fi and VPN settings you switch with one click, or automatically by Wi-Fi network or Ethernet. Applied through NetworkManager with no root and without editing saved connections.

nodes.name: Grok Bot Tray
nodes.author: sunny0826
nodes.description: Keep Grok Bot online: click the bar icon to hide/show its window in a tray workspace, right-click for a menu (auto-update switch, quit). Paired with the grok-bot.service systemd unit for crash supervision.

nodes.name: dsmn
nodes.author: Nom de la Société
nodes.description: Keeps your Omarchy computer awake while a local coding agent is working, then lets it sleep when that work stops. Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Grok, and Pi can keep a timer going from the bar. You can also start 30 minutes, 90 minutes, or a length you choose, up to 8 hours. Stop, or the end of the timer, allows sleep again. The screen can still blank and the session can still lock. Installing it does not add hooks or change sleep settings. Those stay in Settings, and only if you ask.

nodes.name: Omato
nodes.author: mattio
nodes.description: Pomodoro timer with a live countdown in the bar, a daily goal, streaks, and synced session history.

nodes.name: Candela
nodes.author: Pedro Motta
nodes.description: Displays at their real capabilities: arrangement, HDR and wide gamut gated by the panel's EDID, SDR white in cd/m², a safe apply that reverts itself, a home display for each workspace, and virtual displays for a tablet, a call or a test.

nodes.name: LifeOS
nodes.author: staruxian
nodes.description: Tasks, habits, reading and countdowns — your day in one panel.

nodes.name: Workspace Names
nodes.author: zhuangbiaowei
nodes.description: Show each Hyprland workspace with the name of the app occupying it, next to its number.

nodes.name: Network (hide networks)
nodes.author: cdelcollado
nodes.description: Omarchy Wi-Fi bar widget with the ability to hide unwanted networks from scans.

nodes.name: User Services
nodes.author: Gabriel da Silva
nodes.description: Start, stop and restart your systemctl --user services from the bar, with the real RAM and VRAM each one holds. Built for people running heavy local services like AI models, inference servers and GPU jobs.

nodes.name: Galaxy Buds Pro
nodes.author: Oleksii Lysenko (akafrmn), based on work by Aislan Dener Souza Vicentini
nodes.description: Samsung Galaxy Buds Pro, Buds2 Pro, Buds3 Pro and Buds4 Pro in the Omarchy bar: firmware updates without a phone, noise control, per-earbud and case battery with in-case status, low battery warnings, codec, 360 Audio, touch controls and quick connect.

nodes.name: OmaKube
nodes.author: OmaKube
nodes.description: Kubernetes contexts, namespaces, workloads, logs and quick actions — single anchored popup in the Omarchy bar.

nodes.name: Records
