nodes.description: Zero-latency system-wide adblocker, DNS/hosts privacy shield, and OmaBlock Shield Bridge for Chromium on Omarchy Linux.

nodes.name: Centre Split
nodes.author: Babbletrax
nodes.description: Three-window tiling with the half in the centre: 1/4 · 1/2 · 1/4. Also even, thirds, and 50/50.

nodes.name: Caseta Lights
nodes.author: Dogan Demir
nodes.description: Control Lutron Caseta lights, switches, fans and scenes from the Omarchy bar over the Smart Bridge's local LEAP API.

nodes.name: OmaFan
nodes.author: Aayush Pokharel
nodes.description: Fan curves, profiles, and live CPU, GPU, and fan readings for the Framework Desktop.

nodes.name: Nicknow Workspaces
nodes.author: Nicolas Nowinski
nodes.description: Workspace switcher grouped by monitor, with window counts and a window list panel

nodes.name: Crypto
nodes.author: Thales Augusto
nodes.description: Bitcoin and favorite crypto prices in the Omarchy bar — coin logos, 24h change, 7-day sparkline, market stats.

nodes.name: Local services
nodes.author: wszaq
nodes.description: Auto-discovers Docker containers and localhost listeners, grouped as Containers / Localhosts / Ports with on/off filters.

nodes.name: Video Downloader Ultra
nodes.author: Najm
nodes.description: yt-dlp downloads with a shared queue, browser extension + native host, and a live progress OSD. The plugin mirrors the download queue from the Video Downloader Ultra browser extension; the first click installs the extension and host into your Chromium-family browsers.

nodes.name: Omaflow
nodes.author: Tempest
nodes.description: Omaflow is the cooling window and the Omarchy bar chip. Both talk to coolercontrold. The chip can install or start the daemon after you approve it.

nodes.name: MedKit
nodes.author: hshindys
nodes.description: Medication status in the bar: a pill mark, next dose time, daily progress and low-stock warnings. Click to open the panel (doses, safety, health, reports, cards) with an offline emergency card overlay; right-click opens the MedKit dashboard.

nodes.name: AELF
nodes.author: Vianney Gremmel
nodes.description: Lectures de la messe et prière des Heures du jour, depuis l'API de l'AELF

nodes.name: Omateams
nodes.author: Divanyx
nodes.description: Microsoft Teams for Omarchy: the real Teams web client in its own window, re-skinned live with your Omarchy theme. Sign in the normal way, keep calls, meetings and screen sharing, and get an unread badge in the bar plus desktop notifications. Every Fluent design token is remapped to colors.toml, corners follow Hyprland's rounding, and a theme switch restyles the open window without a reload.

nodes.name: Kernel Guard
nodes.author: dragosol
nodes.description: Keeps Limine booting the kernel you actually want. Re-resolves the boot default by identity every boot, tells you when it had to correct it, and gives you a picker to choose any installed kernel for next boot.

nodes.name: Focus
nodes.author: noflairos
nodes.description: Stay focused. Understand your screen time and set limits on distractions, locally on Omarchy.

nodes.name: Dual Monitor Workspaces
nodes.author: Gavin Hayes (LinuxGamerUK)
nodes.description: Persistent numbered workspace banks: 1-5 on the first monitor, 6-10 on the second. SUPER+SHIFT+N sends windows across screens. No external Hyprland plugin required.

nodes.name: Wisp · Machine Familiar
nodes.author: 0xQuan
nodes.description: A personal, evolving local-AI companion with sixteen forms, a pocket room, voice, and a native dream-room screensaver.

nodes.name: Sperax Walking Pad
nodes.author: backmeupplz
nodes.description: Start, stop and set the speed of a Sperax RM-01 (and rebadged, e.g. Freepi) walking pad over Bluetooth, with today's steps in the bar and a 7-day history.

nodes.name: Spitball
nodes.author: supercleanse
nodes.description: Records, transcribes and summarizes your calls. Spitball notices when Zoom, Meet, Slack, Teams or another call app starts using your mic, shows a record button in the bar, and saves the audio, a two-sided transcript and a summary for every call. Transcription runs on your machine with voxtype by default (Deepgram optional), with a live transcript that fills in as people talk. Summaries use any OpenAI-compatible model, a local Ollama by default.

nodes.name: Agents + TeamClaude
nodes.author: supercleanse
nodes.description: Omarchy's Agents panel plus a TeamClaude tab: start and stop the TeamClaude proxy, per-account session and weekly quota meters with prefer, enable and remove controls, and a live request console.

nodes.name: Hardwarchy
nodes.author: Tymur Bogach
nodes.description: Modular hardware monitoring for Omarchy. Minimal in the bar. Customizable in the menu.

nodes.name: Mail
nodes.author: Pavel Petržela
nodes.description: Light terminal Gmail client with arrow-key navigation, categories as Gmail labels, and Jev (TypeSafe AI) auto-sorting.

nodes.name: Nothing Glass
nodes.author: t1nk33r
nodes.description: Desktop widgets in two styles: liquid glass refracting the live wallpaper, or Nothing OS dot-matrix.

nodes.name: BT Battery
nodes.author: joe93
nodes.description: Shows the battery of Bluetooth devices (controllers, headsets, keyboards, mice) in the bar. Reads from the kernel input/hid drivers first, then BlueZ Battery1, and never invents a percentage: devices without a real battery report an honest "no battery" state.

nodes.name: Puck
nodes.author: Vedant
nodes.description: A gentle animated companion with daily care progress, timers, and little promises

nodes.name: Omarchy Vitals
nodes.author: Lucas
nodes.description: Live CPU, memory, temperature and one-hour history in a native popup.

nodes.name: SFL: Secure Fast Login
nodes.author: fabio
nodes.description: Secure Fast Login for Omarchy: encrypted password vault with auto-type, plus hashes, passwords, keys, UUIDs and SSH keypairs, click to copy

nodes.name: Speaker Mode
nodes.author: correia
nodes.description: Turn this machine into a Bluetooth speaker for your phone, with on/off state in the bar.

nodes.name: optination
nodes.author: lubabs770
nodes.description: Pick a cursor theme and size, with live previews

nodes.name: Corsair VOID Elite
nodes.author: AlexR1712
nodes.description: Battery monitoring and hardware controls for the Corsair VOID Elite Wireless headset.

nodes.name: OpenLogi
nodes.author: Alan Frigo
nodes.description: Native OpenLogi Action Ring overlay and connection status for Omarchy.

nodes.name: Access Point
nodes.author: Niall Ó Cléirigh
nodes.description: Shows which access point of a multi-access-point Wi-Fi network you're connected to, and lets you name and switch between them.

nodes.name: Seerr Quick Requests
nodes.author: spicybackend
nodes.description: Search and request TV shows and movies from Seerr in the Omarchy bar.

nodes.name: Zotero Launcher
nodes.author: mbradaschia
nodes.description: Your Zotero library one keystroke away: fuzzy search, notes, tags, journal rankings, and prompts and chat grounded in the paper on the AI model you choose

nodes.name: OmaWhats
nodes.author: megamvb
nodes.description: OmaWhats, a basic WhatsApp client for the Omarchy shell, built on whatsmeow. Text, replies, reactions, photos and files (sent and received). The daemon (omawhatsd) only runs while you switch it on; switched off, stored conversations stay readable.

nodes.name: sing-box dashboard
nodes.author: xi4oh4o
nodes.description: A native Omarchy status bar widget and full-featured control panel for sing-box (specifically optimized for sing-box 1.14+). Built following the official sing-box dashboard design language and Omarchy shell plugin standards.

nodes.name: Camera
nodes.author: yashyadurai
nodes.description: Live laptop camera preview with mirror and snapshot controls.

nodes.name: Hermes Pets
nodes.author: Madmasx
nodes.description: Animated Hermes petdex companion in the Omarchy bar: it plays sprite sheets from ~/.hermes/pets, looks at your cursor, waves when clicked, and can be pinned to the desktop. Reacts to Hermes agent activity when the activity hook is wired in.

nodes.name: FocusFlow
nodes.author: kamal
nodes.description: FocusFlow — Pomodoro timer with tick-tock sound and a to-do list with plain/kanban modes

nodes.name: Ready Room
nodes.author: Greg DeYoung (fork of Austin Larson's dielerorn.gamecenter)
nodes.description: Omarchy gaming panel: a game-mode session (keep-awake, do-not-disturb, night light, performance power profile), controller and gamepad battery + rumble test, a gpu-screen-recorder instant-replay buffer with one-key clip saving, and a CPU/GPU/VRAM stats overlay that pairs with MangoHud for FPS. Replaces six bar widgets with one pre-game ritual.

nodes.name: Infiniarchy
nodes.author: LMajs
nodes.description: Infinite canvas window overview for Omarchy: every window as a live, free-floating tile on one pannable, zoomable canvas. Drag, chain and arrange windows, then click one to jump to it. Toggle with Right Alt + Q (configurable).

nodes.name: OmaNews
nodes.author: Ozan Özdil (ozdil)
nodes.description: Official Omarchy news dispatches, distro releases, category filters, and in-app ReaderModal with Jev AI summary.

nodes.name: Vivobook Control
nodes.author: Leandro Oricchio
nodes.description: ASUS Vivobook S 14 controls: keyboard backlight and RGB, performance mode, charge limit, Copilot key and touchpad gestures in one Omarchy panel.

nodes.name: Pokeget Terminal
nodes.author: Roudis
nodes.description: Shows a random Pokémon sprite (via pokeget) whenever a new terminal opens, and installs pokeget if it's missing.

nodes.name: Easy Calendar
nodes.author: itcaat
nodes.description: Your iCal calendars in the bar. Your next meeting at a glance, and one click to join it.

nodes.name: Battery Limit
nodes.author: brightwalker25
nodes.description: Cap the charge on your battery to preserve it, and raise the cap for travel with an override that expires on its own

nodes.name: Power Menu
nodes.author: RobbieUK1
nodes.description: Power button in the bar with a dropdown for lock, suspend, logout, reboot and shutdown

nodes.name: Obscure
nodes.author: glvr
nodes.description: Obscure — spotlight-style launcher for Omarchy: apps, files, directories, and smart search.

nodes.name: Immich Photos
nodes.author: Badr-Emil
nodes.description: Back up the photos and videos on your phone to this PC over Wi-Fi with a local Immich server: install, monitor and control it from the Omarchy bar, and browse the photos with the keyboard.

nodes.name: Agent Chat
nodes.author: Robson Cassiano
nodes.description: A fullscreen dialog to chat with your default coding agent (pi, omp, or agy) without leaving the desktop.

nodes.name: Agent Pipeline
nodes.author: haomin.ye (ericyhm80)
nodes.description: See what your AI agent actually does: live request paths, reported model/tool activity, timing, cost, health and history. Opt in to Pi or Codex reporters, or manually report checkpoints from Claude Code, OpenClaw, Hermes, GrokBot and other agents via CLI.

nodes.name: headlint
nodes.author: polidog
nodes.description: Type a URL in the bar panel and lint its <head> (OGP, favicon, robots) with headlint (github.com/polidog/headlint). Images are rendered inline.

nodes.name: Nickelbar
nodes.author: Cob Muddybug
nodes.description: One hundred and twenty small games (arcade, midway, puzzle, logic, cards, board, quiz), themed live from the active Omarchy theme.

nodes.name: WiFi Force Connector
nodes.author: Urija Rom
nodes.description: One-click WiFi recovery: a bar button opens a panel with a big CONNECT button that recreates your NetworkManager profile with a freshly typed passphrase. Fixes stale saved-password profiles that leave the machine stuck asking for secrets it can never get.

nodes.name: Docker
nodes.author: Juan
nodes.description: Native Docker container status and controls for the Omarchy bar.

nodes.name: Battery Display Profiles
nodes.author: Hazem-Ahmed-Salem
nodes.description: Automatically switches display profiles based on AC or battery power, with independent multi-monitor support and manual display controls.

nodes.name: Desktop Widget Control
nodes.author: lunanoir21
nodes.description: Live desktop widgets with a full editor for Omarchy — clocks, system monitors, a music player with a live spectrum, calendar and weather, placed and styled on the desktop, in nine themes.

nodes.name: Omapple
nodes.author: Bram van Oploo
nodes.description: Let's keep the Apple hard ware alive. Configuration options and presets tailored for the Mac. Including T2 specific improvements and fixes, if the hardware is detected.

nodes.name: Moush
nodes.author: hanoixan
nodes.description: Keyboard-driven pointer control: move, click and scroll without a mouse. Requires ydotool for clicking and scrolling.

nodes.name: Spotify_Wheel
nodes.author: Adam-loy
nodes.description: Spotify in the Omarchy bar: always present, with background playback, transport, search, and a panel over the current album cover.

nodes.name: OmaKlippy
nodes.author: Bruno
nodes.description: 3D printer status and control for Klipper/Moonraker

nodes.name: AI Agent Assistant
nodes.author: Glunk
nodes.description: Your AI agent assistant widget for the Omarchy status bar, sitting right next to screen time.

nodes.name: PromptBro
nodes.author: supercleanse
nodes.description: A teleprompter that follows your voice. Load a script from the bar, and PromptBro shows it a few lines at a time under the bar and scrolls as you speak. Speech recognition runs on your machine (sherpa-onnx, no cloud, no account, no GPU).

nodes.name: Notch Island
nodes.author: paudelsamir
nodes.description: An edge-anchored notch / pill that rests as an app dock, clock, headlines, weather or quick notes, becomes a media island while music plays, and pops up volume, brightness, now playing, opencode and power.

nodes.name: Hive Portfolio
nodes.author: menobass
nodes.description: Track the balances, Hive Power, voting power and resource credits of any number of Hive accounts from the bar. A tiny avatar rotates through your accounts, flags unclaimed rewards, and pulses (with an optional desktop notification) when voting power is full and mana is being wasted.

nodes.name: Songbook
nodes.author: Rushi Sompura
nodes.description: Music and books for MPD: your folders as queues, world radio, YouTube search and download, audiobooks, and novels read aloud in your own terminal reader.

nodes.name: OmaRandom
nodes.author: Dankestrick
nodes.description: Spin-the-wheel randomizer for Omarchy: up to six named wheels with colors and pictures, spin one or spin all, and reveal the results.

nodes.name: TypeSuggest
nodes.author: Abdulrahman Rahmouni
nodes.description: Windows-style word suggestions while you type, with quick settings in the bar.

nodes.name: Super Clipboard-Snippet
nodes.author: leninzapata
nodes.description: Clipboard history and snippets in one picker: fuzzy search, pins and rich previews, with Clipboard and Snippets tabs switched by the arrow keys

nodes.name: Tablet Mode
nodes.author: uripg
nodes.description: Touch keyboard, portrait rotation, media controls and Zen reading for convertible laptops.

nodes.name: Eco Mode Manager
nodes.author: Lutfi Zain
nodes.description: Toggle eco mode to save battery by disabling GPU blur, animations, capping brightness, and switching power profiles

nodes.name: Glass & Blur
nodes.author: Lutfi Zain
nodes.description: Adjust window opacity, transparency, and glass blur from the bar

nodes.name: Melody
nodes.author: shoxjaxon
nodes.description: A minimal local music player for the Omarchy bar. Choose your music folder once: every song in it, subfolders included, is in one list — click a song and it plays, with no player to start and no player window. A mini-player, your own playlists, and it remembers where you stopped, even after a restart. Also shows other local MPRIS players. No network access, no background scanning.

nodes.name: Vortex
nodes.author: c4pt0r
nodes.description: A bar button that opens thirteen animated ASCII fluid patterns (cyclone, ocean, smoke, Jupiter, matrix...) in your terminal, in monochrome or six color palettes.

nodes.name: Now Playing
nodes.author: Deoxizn
nodes.description: Shows movies currently playing at nearby theatres via BigScreen.com

nodes.name: Quick Settings
nodes.author: Nick Stone
nodes.description: A configurable quick settings panel for opening your installed plugin controls.

nodes.name: Tarot
nodes.author: Julian Duque
nodes.description: A daily tarot card in the Omarchy bar, with A. E. Waite's own meanings, the Golden Dawn attributions, full readings and a markdown journal.

nodes.name: Pill Bar
nodes.author: ishan-parihar
nodes.description: Segmented pill bar — transparent window, pills only behind widget clusters. Includes always-expanded static tray (no chevron) for the segmented layout. Center anchored on calendar.

nodes.name: Agents + Claude Status
nodes.author: AvA_l4nch
nodes.description: Omarchy's agents panel plus live Claude Code session status on the same bar icon: colour and pulse for working, waiting and blocked, and a per-session list under Limits.

nodes.name: Plonk
nodes.author: Fred Nix
nodes.description: Packs numeric Hyprland workspaces into 1…N as gaps appear, preserving order, tiling, monitor placement, and focus.

nodes.name: BatPuter
nodes.author: phaze7r
nodes.description: Gotham-themed tactical productivity HUD for Omarchy with customizable Pomodoro focus, live system telemetry, case files, forensic notes, Alfred comms, and daily standup debrief export.

nodes.name: Token Monitor
nodes.author: shuuul
nodes.description: Amp, Antigravity, Codex, Kimi Code, Cursor, Grok, Notion AI, Zed, and Droid quotas in the Omarchy bar.

nodes.name: Launch Schedule
nodes.author: Dean White
nodes.description: Upcoming space launches, live webcasts, crew, and a text-mode trajectory globe

nodes.name: Adaptive Power
nodes.author: Viktar Hushchynski
nodes.description: Power panel with adaptive battery charging: learns your unplug schedule, holds a charge ceiling, tops up before you leave.

nodes.name: Git Status
nodes.author: nachoaz
nodes.description: Warns when any git repository under your watched folders has work pending to be synchronized: uncommitted changes, untracked files, or unpushed commits.

nodes.name: API Mock
nodes.author: duncanireri
nodes.description: Local mock server for APIs and webhooks, in WireMock's stub format. Point it at a JSON file, pick a port, run it from the bar.

nodes.name: GitHub PR Status
nodes.author: torugo
nodes.description: Your open pull requests, checks, reviews, and discussion counts in the Omarchy bar.

nodes.name: Pangolin
nodes.author: Jurien de Jong
nodes.description: Pangolin client status, connection control, site browsing, alias shortcuts, and quick actions for the Omarchy bar.

nodes.name: Wallsync
nodes.author: jgarza
nodes.description: Pick a wallpaper from a grid of ~/Pictures/Wallpapers; it becomes the background and the whole Omarchy palette is generated from it, with a choice of color profiles.

nodes.name: Window Control & Minimize
nodes.author: Azteriisk
nodes.description: Off-screen application-grouped window minimization, CSD maximize/close support, status badge, and instant multi-workspace restoration for Hyprland

nodes.name: Omarchygotchi
nodes.author: Creazawolf
nodes.description: A little desktop companion with gentle care, real friendships, shared stories, and families.

nodes.name: RelayBar
nodes.author: bayhnf
nodes.description: Agent HUD and interactive chat drawer for Hermes AI in the Omarchy bar.

nodes.name: Omaclasroom
nodes.author: Omaclasroom Contributors
nodes.description: Google Classroom grades and upcoming assignments for the Omarchy bar.

nodes.name: Memento Mori
nodes.author: lookiyam
nodes.description: Days remaining against a configured birth year and life expectancy.

nodes.name: Privacy Pulse
nodes.author: Esegnorelli
nodes.description: Bar indicator for live microphone, camera, and screen-share capture. Shows which apps are using your sensors right now.

nodes.name: Break Time
nodes.author: Edgars Mjasnikovs
nodes.description: Reminds you to drink water and stretch your legs after a while at the screen. Snooze for 5 minutes.

nodes.name: YouTube Music
nodes.author: sebasgl23
nodes.description: Lightweight theme-aware YouTube Music player and bar widget for Omarchy.

nodes.name: AGY Token Usage
nodes.author: Antigravity
nodes.description: Antigravity (AGY) token usage, prompt pace, and session metrics in a native Omarchy bar panel.

nodes.name: AirPods
nodes.author: Augusto Soto
nodes.description: Battery, noise control and ear detection for AirPods, driven through the airpods-tui daemon

nodes.name: Display & profiles
nodes.author: Aaron Sanz Roca
nodes.description: Display controls (brightness, warmth, scale, text size) plus a native monitor profile switcher. Selecting a profile rewrites ~/.config/hypr/monitors.lua, enabling/disabling the chosen monitors. Profiles live in ~/.config/omarchy/monitor-profiles/.

nodes.name: ESPN Scores
nodes.author: Marcus Myers
nodes.description: Live ESPN scores in the Omarchy bar.

nodes.name: Omakamal
nodes.author: almoramx
nodes.description: Your Kamal-deployed apps in the Omarchy bar: the version running on each server, an inline log tail, and a terminal into logs, console, or shell — each repo's own deploy.yml doing the talking.

nodes.name: Trackpad Settings
nodes.author: Yashasewi Singh
nodes.description: Pointer and trackpad controls for Hyprland.

nodes.name: Menu (Escape unwinds)
nodes.author: Sumiran Dahal
nodes.description: Omarchy menu fork where Escape backs out one level instead of closing the whole menu.

nodes.name: Display Layout
nodes.author: Badr-Emil
nodes.description: Arrange and rotate your displays and choose which workspace number each one shows, right from the Omarchy bar.

nodes.name: Window switcher
nodes.author: Josip Povreslo
nodes.description: Fuzzy-search open Hyprland windows and focus one

nodes.name: Gadget Batteries
nodes.author: 69Harold69
nodes.description: One bar widget for the battery of every connected gadget, replacing separate AirPods, Logitech and headset widgets: Bluetooth and Logitech devices, USB/2.4 GHz headsets, Galaxy Buds, Fast Pair earbuds, AirPods, Xinmeng 2.4G keyboards and your own scripts.

nodes.name: Minimize & Tray
nodes.author: Phill
nodes.description: Windows-style titlebar buttons (minimise / maximise / close), a minimise-to-tray preview dock, and a close confirmation prompt.

nodes.name: Monitor Power
nodes.author: StavWasPlayZ
nodes.description: Switch any one monitor off and back on from a map of your monitors, opened from Trigger > Monitors in the Omarchy menu.

nodes.name: Keystrokes
nodes.author: markpriem
nodes.description: Shows the keys you press as themed keycaps on screen, for screencasts, streams and teaching. Toggle it from the menu, a keybinding or IPC.

nodes.name: Hours
nodes.author: aniketpatidar
nodes.description: A quiet record of where your screen time goes. Nothing leaves this machine.

nodes.name: Jalali Calendar
nodes.author: Masoud Yousefnejad
nodes.description: تقویم شمسی و میلادی در نوار اُمارچی، با فونت وزیرمتن و همگام‌سازی با گوگل کلندر یا هر سرور CalDAV (سرور ایمیل سازمانی، Nextcloud، Fastmail و…) — A switchable Jalali / Gregorian calendar for the Omarchy bar, syncing from Google Calendar or any CalDAV server.

nodes.name: Marvin
nodes.author: Cloud First Consulting
nodes.description: Say "Hey Marvin" and it opens apps, switches workspaces, tells you which key does what from your live bindings, or works out why Bluetooth will not connect. Wake word, transcription and speech run locally; only the text of an unrecognised request goes to the coding agent Omarchy is already set to. Audio never leaves the machine.

nodes.name: Slack
nodes.author: Pavel Petržela
nodes.description: Fast terminal Slack: one conversation on the screen, Ctrl+P to any other, live over Socket Mode.

nodes.name: Trello
nodes.author: Pavel Petržela
nodes.description: Fast terminal Trello: arrow keys, Ctrl+P to any card, and a history that brings back deleted checklists, items, cards and comments.

nodes.name: Omafishin'
nodes.author: swasko
nodes.description: Best fishing times and days from the bar: solunar, tide, and weather forecasts from the fishin' app

nodes.name: 1-Click Omarchy Print
nodes.author: Darkosxl
nodes.description: One-click PDF printing from the Omarchy bar: pick a printer and a PDF in a small popup, press Print.

nodes.name: Window Dust
nodes.author: qempexe
nodes.description: Windows you have not touched slowly fade and gather real dust motes; focusing one blows them clean. Fully configurable.

nodes.name: iMsg
nodes.author: nikolaos
nodes.description: Read and send iPhone texts over Bluetooth from a terminal-style overlay.

nodes.name: Reword
nodes.author: John Pollard
nodes.description: Rewrite selected or copied text with your own AI key, then replace it or copy the result.

nodes.name: OmaPasswords
nodes.author: Ronald Craig
nodes.description: Strong random passwords one click from the bar, made from your system's secure random source.

nodes.name: VPN Units
nodes.author: SmartALB
nodes.description: OpenVPN and WireGuard as systemd units -- so a mount or service that depends on a tunnel keeps working. Imports .ovpn and .conf files through a checked allowlist; certificate and key auth only.

nodes.name: Ominder
nodes.author: Excalimbito
nodes.description: Reminders for Omarchy: flexible times, repeats, snooze, sound, and a management panel

nodes.name: OmaOvercast
nodes.author: RobertStevenson
nodes.description: Unofficial Overcast player for the Omarchy bar: browse your subscriptions, play episodes with mpv, and sync progress and speed back to your Overcast account.

nodes.name: Foamy Notifications
nodes.author: foamrider
nodes.description: Foamy notification popups with grouping, actions, monitor selection, and fullscreen controls

nodes.name: OmaLlamaCpp
nodes.author: LinuxGamerUK
nodes.description: Control a local llama.cpp llama-server from the Omarchy bar. Start and stop it as a user systemd service, see VRAM use, the loaded model and context, and switch between local .gguf models on disk.

nodes.name: Luddite PXE Dust
nodes.author: TechLuddite
nodes.description: Serve the Omarchy installer on your existing LAN or a dedicated Ethernet network

nodes.name: sing-box Bar
nodes.author: legibet
nodes.description: The sing-box already running on this machine, in the Omarchy bar: status, the outbound of each group, URL tests, and starting or stopping the service.

nodes.name: Klipsch / SA9226 PCM
nodes.author: TumbleweedLabs
nodes.description: Safe, separate hardware gain for Klipsch The Fives and other SA9226 USB audio outputs—right from your Omarchy bar

nodes.name: Hecate
nodes.author: m10ust
nodes.description: Guided three-corner backups. One source, three destinations that can fail independently.

nodes.name: Now Playing OSD
nodes.author: skoom
nodes.description: Drop-in replacement for the Omarchy OSD that attaches now-playing metadata — album art, title, artist, album, and elapsed/total time — to the volume and brightness overlays.

nodes.name: InstantCampaign Spark
nodes.author: Cloud First Consulting
nodes.description: Live email and website analytics from your InstantCampaign workspace in the Omarchy bar: sends, open and click rates with their trend, recent campaigns, sending-domain health and warm-up, and website traffic. Read-only, over the InstantCampaign MCP endpoint at instantcampaign.ai with an API key you keep in a file only you can read.

nodes.name: Framelet
nodes.author: vxavierr
nodes.description: A small atelier for screenshots. Capture, annotate and finish in one native overlay.

nodes.name: OmaOpus
nodes.author: MaenExists
nodes.description: Lightning-fast, ultra-lightweight YouTube music player for Omarchy OS. Stream any track in under a second with background pre-caching, real-time 32-band spectrum equalizer audio visualizer, seamless queue autoplay, persistent favorites, and a sleek top bar widget that runs under 15MB RAM.

nodes.name: My Network
nodes.author: elliotalien
nodes.description: Multi-radio Wi-Fi panel: browse networks per adapter with per-adapter connection state and stats (IP, gateway, ping, throughput), connect/disconnect/forget, DNS provider switching, QR share, speed test, and VPN route labeling.

nodes.name: yeet-ai
nodes.author: yeet
nodes.description: Ask for a chart of this host and get one, live, in the bar. yeet-ai writes a subscription over the system graph and draws what arrives: dashboards, gauges, heat maps, rankings, in your theme's colours.

nodes.name: OmaKeys
nodes.author: skvggor
nodes.description: Shows the keys you press and the mouse buttons you click as a floating on-screen overlay plus a bar indicator. Made for screencasts, live demos, and teaching.

nodes.name: SeamlessControl
nodes.author: PuroDelphi
nodes.description: Share mouse, keyboard, clipboard and files across Omarchy and Windows

nodes.name: omabisync
nodes.author: hverbruggen
nodes.description: Status of rclone bisync with cloud storage: last and next sync, recent runs, and which files moved.

nodes.author: akitwra
nodes.description: AirDrop-compatible sharing for Omarchy with honest hardware diagnostics.

nodes.name: Agent Pet
nodes.author: lia
nodes.description: Desktop pet ported from dsh-pet: idle animations, drag and throw, and live Claude Code / Codex work status. Work status needs the agent hooks installed manually; see the repository README.

nodes.name: Keyglow
nodes.author: Alex
nodes.description: Corsair keyboard lighting from the Omarchy bar: colour, brightness and RGB effects, applied through OpenLinkHub

nodes.name: Laser
nodes.author: Yasser
nodes.description: Laser focus for Omarchy. Tell it what you're working on; it notices when you drift and pulls you back. Classified by TypeSafe Jev with your own API key, privacy-first.

nodes.name: Omarchy Canvas
nodes.author: Filip Magnusson
nodes.description: Read-only Canvas assignments due in the next seven days, with submission status and browser links.

nodes.name: Ente Auth dropdown
nodes.author: meviusisback
nodes.description: Real Ente Auth desktop app as a dropdown overlay: bar lock icon plus SUPER+E toggle on a special workspace. Login, E2EE sync and codes stay inside Ente Auth.

nodes.name: KeyController
nodes.author: KeyController contributors
nodes.description: OpenSSH keys with per-key passphrase and fingerprint unlock

nodes.name: Control Panel
nodes.author: Atanas Chalakov
nodes.description: Graphical settings and control panel for Omarchy desktop

nodes.name: Remmina for NetBird
nodes.author: Rory Carter
nodes.description: Discovers RDP, SSH and VNC services on your NetBird peers, keeps matching Remmina profiles in sync, and launches them from the bar.

nodes.name: Pocket Pair
nodes.author: RibatTRW
nodes.description: Sign in to the Moshi phone terminal from Omarchy: one panel checks the machine, fixes what is missing, and shows the pairing QR.

nodes.name: Downtime
nodes.author: heast13
nodes.description: Screensaver, screen-off, sleep, shutdown timer and wallpaper rotation in one bar widget.

nodes.name: Apple T2 Thermal
nodes.author: Gandalf
nodes.description: MacBook Pro T2 CPU, dGPU temperatures and fan controls in the Omarchy bar.

nodes.name: Owww
nodes.author: Rich Feather
nodes.description: Plays a short owww when the charger is plugged in.

nodes.name: Sling
nodes.author: Alex Weström
nodes.description: Sling - Zero-App QR file sharing between phone and PC for Omarchy. One manual step on a stock Omarchy: let the port through the firewall (sudo ufw allow 5380/tcp) - the plugin itself needs no setup.

nodes.name: Omatune
nodes.author: qempexe
nodes.description: Song recognition in your Omarchy bar: click to listen, then see the song, artist and cover in a notification and in the history. First use offers a one-click SongRec install.

nodes.name: Background Worker Talk To Me
nodes.author: AktOn1
nodes.description: Lets an AI agent that tests on your desktop tell you first and ask you quick questions. A heads-up countdown (pause, postpone or cancel), a TESTING badge with the expected time, one-key answers (Y, N, ?) or a typed reply returned to the command line, and a guard that makes agents announce themselves before they touch your windows.

nodes.name: Jarvis
nodes.author: grivera
nodes.description: Jarvis, your voice assistant: press the Copilot key and say what you want: open apps, close or move windows, switch workspaces, volume, music and more. Speech is recognized and spoken locally; anything beyond the built-in commands is planned by Claude or Codex.

nodes.name: Asana
nodes.author: Thomas Torggler
nodes.description: Your Asana My Tasks list, grouped by section, in a keyboard-driven bar popup.

nodes.name: Agenda
nodes.author: danitrrga
nodes.description: The calendar block running now and the next one in the bar, with the day and week agenda in a panel

nodes.name: Omarchy News Ticker
nodes.author: Hennie De Bruin
nodes.description: RSS headlines for your bar, with scrolling, topic switching, and UK/US country-aware news.

nodes.name: Close Guard
nodes.author: Ayan De
nodes.description: Asks "Are you sure you want to close?" before Super+W closes a window. No is selected by default.

nodes.name: Spectrum
nodes.author: Dragos Robu
nodes.description: See your music, live in your bar. Ten octave bands move with whatever is playing; hover for a 60-band, 1/6-octave spectrum split into lows, mids and highs, with peak hold and a balance readout, tinted from your theme. Read-only: it only listens to a sink monitor, and the capture stops when paused.

nodes.name: Switch Magic
nodes.author: Renan Tonheiro (@renanmt)
nodes.description: A visual workspace and window switcher with customizable shortcuts, layouts, and live previews.

nodes.name: Search Menu Items
nodes.author: MaNi4
nodes.description: Search the menu items of the focused app. One key lists File, Edit, Help and the rest with their shortcuts in an Omarchy menu; type to search, step into a menu, and run what you pick in the app

nodes.name: ascii.rest Screensaver
nodes.author: Taras Kornichuk
nodes.description: Idle screensaver that plays the 15 full-colour ascii.rest scenes (by @bas3line). Clones omarchy.idle; falls back to the stock screensaver when Node.js is missing.

nodes.name: Help Rune
nodes.author: uno88-byte
nodes.description: A ? button in the bar that shows Omarchy keybindings. SUPER+I to open help. Beginner-friendly.

nodes.name: Psywall
nodes.author: Dragos Robu
nodes.description: Your wallpaper and your Philips Hue lights, moving to whatever's playing. A subtle oil-slick tint flows through the dark parts of the wallpaper, and up to 10 Hue lights stream 50 times a second, passing the beat around the room instead of pulsing together. Pair the bridge, pick your lights and drag each one to where it stands, all from the bar.

nodes.name: Omakeylog
nodes.author: cesarfilho
nodes.description: Measures how often you press each key, key-pair and short sequence to help you design a better QMK keymap: home-row placement, thumb and layer keys, less finger travel, home-row-mod timing. It keeps aggregate counts only, never the text you type, and shows a keyboard heatmap, finger load, same-finger pairs, trigram patterns, shortcuts and a suggested TAPPING_TERM. It can use your Vial keymap for fingering.

nodes.name: Key Rain
nodes.author: dfrost90
nodes.description: Click-through falling keystrokes with a layout control panel.

nodes.name: Zapret2
nodes.author: krieziey
nodes.description: zapret2 DPI bypass as an Omarchy app: one-click install of the official engine, strategy presets, lists, reachability checks, autopick and blockcheck2, with a bar widget for quick on/off.

nodes.name: Monet: Design Review
nodes.author: Monet
nodes.description: Pick up the site you are building and review it in Monet: capture it, mark it up, and hand the notes to your agent.

nodes.name: Dell G16 AWCC-Oma
nodes.author: rikalonikola
nodes.description: Alienware Command Center alternative made for the Dell G16: thermal profiles, fan boost, keyboard lighting and sensors, with the F7 light key and the G key. Checks the laptop model before it writes to any hardware. Needs the bundled awcc CLI.

nodes.name: Pupa
nodes.author: nathankramm
nodes.description: Monarch Money in your bar: this month's spending pace against your usual month, as a butterfly. Read-only, unofficial.

nodes.name: OmaSkins
nodes.author: JesusLovesYou1013
nodes.description: Add and switch themes, backgrounds and fonts, and rotate them on a schedule. Rounded corners and five steps of window transparency. Can skip and pause rotation of themes and backgrounds separately. If you're into mix and match craziness, try Mix it up: something new every switch, random theme and background combos from the ones you've enabled. Removing OmaSkins reverts rounded corners and transparency to Omarchy default, but all themes, backgrounds and fonts installed while using it remain.

nodes.name: Time Tracker
nodes.author: nabdalla
nodes.description: A free time tracker app for Omarchy: one click on an activity starts its timer. Events log, a pie-chart timeline by day, week, month or year, daily and weekly goals, CSV export. The bar shows what's running; click it to open the app. Fully local: nothing leaves your machine.

nodes.name: Keyritual
nodes.author: Syfra3
nodes.description: A native typing-practice ritual with a Rust engine, local records, and an Omarchy-themed overlay.

nodes.name: MailFlow
nodes.author: Martijn
nodes.description: Unread mail from your self-hosted MailFlow in the bar.

nodes.name: YubiKey OTP
nodes.author: Martijn
nodes.description: TOTP codes from your YubiKey in the bar, shown only after a touch.

nodes.name: Arcula
nodes.author: goldbarth
nodes.description: Unofficial quick access to your JetBrains Toolbox projects and IDEs from the bar.

nodes.name: Numr
nodes.author: quickshell-dotfiles
nodes.description: Natural language calculator powered by numr-cli

nodes.name: VibeBuddy
nodes.author: Second State
nodes.description: The VibeBuddy box in your bar: whether it's online, its mode, today's stats and its volume.

nodes.name: HEIC Dynamic Desktop
nodes.author: Omarchy HEIC contributors
nodes.description: Import HEIC/HEIF dynamic wallpapers, inspect frames and preview a day on your desktop. Supports time, solar and light/dark schedules via timewall. Install the bar plugin, then prepare timewall and set up the user service; see the README's Install on Omarchy steps.

nodes.name: Omakey
nodes.author: gladimdim
nodes.description: Use your phone as a real keyboard. Pair the Omakey app with a QR code and type, hold SUPER + SPACE, press F1-F12 and Esc, over Wi-Fi.

nodes.name: Mac Battery Limit
nodes.author: geoochi
nodes.description: Battery state and a charge-limit stepper for Apple Silicon MacBooks, backed by the battctl firmware threshold tool.

nodes.name: Photo screensaver
nodes.author: nikolaos
nodes.description: Show photos from a folder as a screensaver: full page, film strip, polaroids, or a grid.

nodes.name: True Glass
nodes.author: Eddie175
nodes.description: Real glass for Omarchy. The bar, menus, notifications and windows bend the light at their edges like a lens, and menus pour out of the bar like liquid. Auto frost, Dark and Light glass, Thin or Thick, round corners, six window light styles, clear terminals and a glass lock screen. Works with every theme, light on resources, and turning it off puts everything back.

nodes.name: Colorful Terminals
nodes.author: Andrei Yurik
nodes.description: Never type into the wrong terminal again: every project gets its own background color, and Super+Ctrl+Alt+1…9 opens it. Ghostty, Kitty, Alacritty and foot; bash, zsh, fish and tmux.

nodes.name: Omarchy Guardian
nodes.author: gosumarchy
nodes.description: Omarchy Guardian's protection status in the bar: gates, problems to fix and the last block. Needs Omarchy Guardian installed.

nodes.name: omaotp
nodes.author: qempexe
nodes.description: TOTP authenticator for the Omarchy bar: one-time codes with countdown rings, stored in an encrypted local vault.

nodes.name: Bouncer: Focus To-Do List
nodes.author: Bennet
nodes.description: A to-do list that keeps you focused. Your distracting sites and apps stay blocked until an agent has checked that today's tasks are done.

nodes.name: Background Umami
nodes.author: Sam Jage
nodes.description: Umami for your background. Season to taste. Omarchy is omakase: every theme comes with wallpapers the chef picked, and they're good. Umami is the seasoning on the table for when you want a little more. Browse everything you've got, see it on your desktop before you commit, keep it when you change themes, or let it shuffle. Stock Omarchy stays exactly as it is.

nodes.name: OmaHomepage
nodes.author: BlogVirtualizado / OmaOps
nodes.description: Native Omarchy bar client for browsing and managing gethomepage/Homepage services.

nodes.name: OMARemote
nodes.author: Roelof de Groot
nodes.description: OMARemote, the RDP, VNC and SSH remote desktop client, in the Omarchy bar: running sessions and favourite connections, one click to bring a session forward or connect. Offers to install OMARemote when it is missing.

nodes.name: Hebrew Keyboard Overlay
nodes.author: mtesseract
nodes.description: Shows the Hebrew keyboard layout, including niqqud, for typing Hebrew on a keyboard without Hebrew keycaps

nodes.name: Fcitx5 input method
nodes.author: eren
nodes.description: Shows and toggles the current Fcitx5 input method

nodes.name: Grok Bot Usage
nodes.author: solary
nodes.description: Grok Bot weekly usage on the Omarchy bar (Grok Bot face + remaining meter, same slot as omarchy-grok-cursor-usage), with popup charts of remaining Grok Bot and Cursor Auto/API quota against even pace.

nodes.name: Zabbix Problems
nodes.author: geoweir
nodes.description: Omarchy bar widget showing Zabbix Problems counts for disaster, high, average, and warning severities.

nodes.name: OmaMessenger
nodes.author: OmaMessenger contributors
nodes.description: A keyboard-first unified messaging client for Omarchy.

nodes.name: Carnelian
nodes.author: Derek Ross
nodes.description: Publish what you write in Omawrite to Nostr as a long-form article (NIP-23), from the Omarchy Share menu. Uploads local images to your Blossom servers and signs through Opal. Adds the command and menu entries: run dist/install.sh.

nodes.name: Floaterr
nodes.author: 35c0b4r
nodes.description: Move windows by holding the middle mouse button and dragging. Toggle it from the bar.

nodes.name: Wallpaper Drop
nodes.author: kaktyc
nodes.description: Drop wallpapers from your file manager into a dedicated folder, preview them in a grid (GIFs and videos animate), and apply with Omarchy's smooth wallpaper transition.

nodes.name: OmaLint
nodes.author: David Gudovic
nodes.description: Finds problems in your Omarchy shell plugins and bar setup: broken manifests, dead bar entries, keybinding conflicts, missing dependencies, modified plugins, and plugin errors in the shell log. Read-only unless you ask it to fix.

nodes.name: C411 Trend
nodes.author: XNinety9
nodes.description: C411 private tracker stats in the Omarchy bar: upload, download and ratio history, charts, forecasts and a what-if calculator ("20 TB uploaded in 2 months at this pace"). Reads your c411.org session cookie from your browser, locally; see SECURITY.md.

nodes.name: UPS Status
nodes.author: jim
nodes.description: An apcupsd UPS on the bar: battery charge, minutes left on battery, load, and the machines it powers, with a notification when mains power is lost or restored.

nodes.name: Satscope
nodes.author: maurice
nodes.description: Bitcoin at a glance: price and sparkline in the bar, plus a panel with on-chain metrics, ETF flows, prediction-market odds, and curated news.

nodes.name: TaskQ
nodes.author: sendaljpt
nodes.description: Daily to-do list in the bar with deadlines and colour-coded countdowns

nodes.name: Light
nodes.author: Light contributors
nodes.description: A local-first Bible reader and Christian radio player for the Omarchy bar.

nodes.name: Theme Manager
nodes.author: Uwe Bruckhaus
nodes.description: Every Omarchy theme in one list, user and system: apply, hide or delete a theme, and manage each theme's wallpapers: add them by drag & drop, paste or web search, hide or delete them. Hidden themes and wallpapers also disappear from Omarchy's own theme and background pickers. Browse and install new themes from omarchy.org.

nodes.name: Media
nodes.author: José Luis
nodes.description: Now-playing MPRIS bar widget: a cava audio spectrum with the cover art in a circle, and a panel with cover, title/artist, media controls and a live seek bar.

nodes.name: ThinkPad Keyboard Backlight
nodes.author: remigius-labs
nodes.description: Keyboard backlight control for ThinkPads: toggle, off/low/high, and a sundown schedule that follows your timezone.

nodes.name: AI Scratchpad
nodes.author: MaNi4
nodes.description: A scratchpad workspace with your AI agent in it. One key slides in a full-screen terminal running Claude Code, Codex or any other agent in the folder you choose; the same key hides it again

nodes.name: OmaWrapped
nodes.author: David Gudovic
nodes.description: Your week on Omarchy as a shareable card: screen time, top apps, busiest day and hour, and git commits. Counted by the shell itself and kept on your machine.

nodes.name: Weather
nodes.author: José Luis
nodes.description: Compact weather for the bar with a details popup: current conditions, a click-to-edit location picker, and a multi-day forecast. Data from Open-Meteo, sharing omarchy's stored weather location.

nodes.name: Keylane
nodes.author: alexpomsft
nodes.description: Bar indicator for the Keylane password manager: shows whether your KeePass vault is locked, opens the launcher, and locks with a click.

nodes.name: Synced Todos
nodes.author: jeanhuit
nodes.description: Obsidian-tasks todo list backed by markdown in a Syncthing-synced Obsidian vault.

nodes.name: Omnicast
nodes.author: Koustav
nodes.description: Alt+Space umbrella launcher for Omarchy: instant file search, live code preview, quicklinks, and script commands.

nodes.name: Fan Control
nodes.author: Karel Diaz Alfonso
nodes.description: nbfc fan control: speed slider and automatic mode

nodes.name: Hormuz Personal Optimizer
nodes.author: Hormuz contributors
nodes.description: Launch a saved Hormuz coding-agent profile, control local optimization, and inspect content-free benefit measurements from the Omarchy bar.

nodes.name: Stage Layout
nodes.author: Sulejman Sarajlija
nodes.description: Stage Manager-style layout for Hyprland: one window in the middle, the rest as thumbnails on both sides. Adds a stage step to SUPER+L.

nodes.name: RustDesk Fullscreen Passthrough
nodes.author: Kaaldev
nodes.description: Pass local shortcuts to fullscreen RustDesk sessions; press Super+F to return to your local desktop.

nodes.name: Familiar Desktop
nodes.author: Tom Ballard and rosakodu
nodes.description: Mouse-friendly dock and optional title-bar controls with General, Windows, and Mac layouts for Omarchy Quattro.

nodes.name: Glicomy
nodes.author: weppami
nodes.description: Blood-glucose log for several people: readings in mg/dL or mmol/L checked against ADA targets before and after meals, 7/30-day charts and statistics, and PDF/CSV reports. Stores everything locally, no network access.

nodes.name: Meeting Mode
nodes.author: Jim Burchel
nodes.description: Join any call and your desktop goes quiet by itself: Do Not Disturb, no idle lock, night light off, voice assistants muted. Hang up and it all comes back. Works with Meet, Zoom, Teams, Slack and Discord, in the browser or the app.

nodes.name: Logitech Headset
nodes.author: saurasanchezpablo
nodes.description: G HUB-style control for Logitech G headsets (G733 tested): battery, the headset's own 10-band EQ with presets and per-app profiles, sidetone, voice processing for the mic, and virtual surround.

nodes.name: Omapantry
nodes.author: heelgueta
nodes.description: A tiny start menu: every installed app, webapp and TUI, sorted by recent use, frequency, name, install date, size, category or never-used

nodes.name: Ombre
nodes.author: ekkostech
nodes.description: Shade each running terminal its own way: a tint, an Aether mood, an Omarchy theme or, in Ghostty, its own wallpaper and text shadow, with a border that pulses when its agent is done. Picked with live previews, without restarting what runs inside.

nodes.name: DroidCam
nodes.author: saurasanchezpablo
nodes.description: Use your phone as a webcam with DroidCam: connects at login over Wi-Fi or USB, reconnects when the stream drops, and puts zoom, focus, torch, mirror and a setup check in the bar.

nodes.name: Apple Music
nodes.author: diegohades
nodes.description: Apple Music on Omarchy: launches music.apple.com as a dedicated Chromium app and controls it from the bar.

nodes.name: OmaShaders
nodes.author: AktOn1
nodes.description: Brand new (one day old, expect rough edges). One bar icon opens menus for 38 full-screen GPU shader effects, 44 colour grades, 41 animated wallpaper effects and 24 cursor effects (overlays, plus shaders that bend the screen under the pointer). Hover to preview, strength slider per effect (starts readable), favourites, combos, pause key, GPU use.

nodes.name: Cockpit
nodes.author: ekkostech
nodes.description: Every repo, worktree and agent terminal on your desktop in one keyboard-driven overlay: branches, dirty and unpushed work, who is working where, and warnings when two agents share a branch. Shows ekkOS work claims from other machines when ekkOS Personal is installed.

nodes.author: pwnsxb
nodes.description: The classic 2048 sliding-tile game in a keyboard-driven, theme-aware Omarchy bar panel.

nodes.name: Omaudible: Omarchy Audible
nodes.author: latentoperator
nodes.description: Your Audible library in the Omarchy bar: browse, download, and listen without a browser tab.

nodes.name: Yagi
nodes.author: Richard Bacci
nodes.description: OTA live TV: scan, watch, guide, record, and pause-live on a dual tuner.

nodes.name: omarunner
nodes.author: thevideinfra
nodes.description: KRunner-style launcher for Omarchy: apps, the Omarchy menu, files, folders, open windows, calculator and unit conversion, clipboard history, shell commands and web search, with Ctrl+number quick launch and in-launcher settings

nodes.name: GeForce NOW Menu
nodes.author: Matt Dance
nodes.description: Search GeForce NOW and add titles as native Omarchy Apps launchers.

nodes.name: Coding Plan Usage
nodes.author: pader
nodes.description: Coding-plan quota usage for LLM platforms (GLM first): an icon with the used percent in the bar, and a popup with per-window meters, token usage, and reset times.

nodes.name: Screensaver Lock
nodes.author: David Boulay
nodes.description: Locks the session every time the screensaver is dismissed, behind a black curtain so the desktop never shows before the lock screen.

nodes.name: Tracearr
nodes.author: jmb11111
nodes.description: Active Plex/Jellyfin/Emby streams from Tracearr in the bar, with a popup showing who is watching what and today's totals.

nodes.name: renCal Clock
nodes.author: jmb11111
nodes.description: Omarchy's clock and calendar popup, plus your upcoming renCal events with one-click Join buttons for video calls.

nodes.name: Everywall
nodes.author: Pierre Nel
nodes.description: Adds the images in ~/Pictures/Wallpapers to the background switcher of every theme.

nodes.name: Uber Notebook
nodes.author: marcho78
nodes.description: Your notes in the Omarchy shell. Press Super+N (or click the notebook in the top bar) and Pages opens: a workspace of pages made of blocks, the Notion way, with to-dos, toggles, tables, boards, mind maps, sketches, equations, diagrams, pictures and files, and your AI agent (Claude Code, Grok or Codex) working on a page in a panel. Or paper notebooks that move to Pages in a click. Quick notes from anywhere with Super+Alt+N, search across everything, and plain files in ~/Documents/Uber Notebook.

nodes.name: Wallpaper Rotate
nodes.author: contra
nodes.description: Rotate the desktop background through the current theme's wallpapers on a timer. One shell timer and no polling: nothing runs between rotations, and it skips while the screen is locked.

nodes.name: Browser Status
nodes.author: somethim
nodes.description: Shows your default browser while it runs, with its windows, processes, memory, and CPU, and can keep Chromium browsers running for web notifications

nodes.name: Net Rain
nodes.author: Soham Datta
nodes.description: A tiny matrix-style network monitor for the Omarchy bar. Square dots fall for download and rise for upload, faster and hotter as speed climbs. No text, no clicks.

nodes.name: Power Rename
nodes.author: BasantPandey
nodes.description: Preview a bulk rename, block name clashes, and undo the change.

nodes.name: oma-peek
nodes.author: Miles McGuire
nodes.description: Quick Look-style 3D previews in Nautilus: thumbnails and spacebar previews for STL, 3MF, OBJ, SCAD, STEP, IGES and glTF. Builds and installs itself when the shell starts.

nodes.name: Token activity
nodes.author: cynricantao
nodes.description: Compact local token history from the shared read-only snapshot.

nodes.name: System Monitor
nodes.author: cynricantao
nodes.description: Lightweight CPU, RAM and NVIDIA GPU dashboard with application-grouped processes.

nodes.name: Liquid Widgets
nodes.author: kaktyc
nodes.description: Desktop widgets with the hyprglass liquid-glass effect: clock, load monitor, graphics card, memory, power profile and battery. Toggle each widget from the bar popup, drag them anywhere with the right mouse button and resize them by dragging a corner.

nodes.name: WLAN Monitor
nodes.author: uBruckhaus
nodes.description: See who is on your Wi-Fi from the bar: every device with name, maker and model (online or sleeping), one click to your router's and devices' web pages, plus signal, link speed and live traffic. Active scans only on networks you trust.

nodes.name: DSLR Webcam
nodes.author: amagdy46
nodes.description: Use a Canon/Nikon/Sony camera as an always-on webcam via gphoto2 and v4l2loopback, with a bar toggle.

nodes.name: Clipboard Cards
nodes.author: Greg Gregorowicz
nodes.description: Omarchy's clipboard manager with a card layout: history list and a separate preview panel

nodes.name: Shell-Swapper
nodes.author: DasPoxy
nodes.description: Swap between shell loadouts (Omarchy's bar, Slime Shell, Ruixen...) in a keystroke. Each keeps its own layout; every swap is backed up and reverts itself unless you keep it.

nodes.name: Layout Indicator
nodes.author: Pawel Warowny
nodes.description: Shows the Hyprland tiling layout of the focused workspace as a single icon.

nodes.name: PMG
nodes.author: SafeDep
nodes.description: Supply-chain protection in the bar: a package icon that shows PMG's status and alerts when it blocks a malicious install.

nodes.name: Per-Monitor Background
nodes.author: John Holloway
nodes.description: Pick a background for each monitor: double-click its desktop, or use the background picker hotkey or menu for the focused monitor.

nodes.name: StartBar
nodes.author: Bernard Maltais
nodes.description: A Windows 11-style taskbar with a Start menu for Omarchy: every open window on every workspace and monitor, plus pinned apps.

nodes.name: Spotlight
nodes.author: cynricantao
nodes.description: Private local search, calculator, web and default-agent terminal handoff

nodes.name: Piphone
nodes.author: areu01or00
nodes.description: Hand your iPhone a mandate and let a Pi agent run it over WebDriverAgent.

nodes.name: Display Setups
nodes.author: Victor Gillholm
nodes.description: Mirror, extend or arrange your displays in a click, set resolution and workspaces per screen, and get the same setup back automatically for every dock, desk and projector you plug into.

nodes.name: Music Assistant
nodes.author: Robert Wilson (rwilson131)
nodes.description: Control Music Assistant from the Omarchy bar: now playing, transport, players and grouping, queue, search, browse, favorites, playlists and recent. Optional media-key bindings.

nodes.name: Omagenda
nodes.author: andre
nodes.description: A calendar in the Omarchy bar: a rolling grid of the week you are in and the two ahead, a year view, a day agenda with event detail and compose pages, and your own events kept in a plain JSON file. Google Calendar syncs both ways at one button press, or leave it off and stay entirely local.

nodes.name: Moonshine
nodes.author: Abi
nodes.description: Whole-screen dimming and Omarchy night-light control

nodes.name: Hue Lights
nodes.author: uBruckhaus
nodes.description: Control your Philips Hue lights from the bar: rooms and single lights on/off, brightness and scenes, straight over your local Hue bridge (no cloud, pinned HTTPS).

nodes.name: Flying Tulip
nodes.author: Flying Tulip
nodes.description: Flying Tulip in the Omarchy bar: FT market price, 24h application fees and, for a wallet you set, health factor with liquidation alerts, PnL, rewards, points and ftPUT gain. Public API only.

nodes.name: Make It Real
nodes.author: Signal Directive
nodes.description: An interactive first-run welcome that shows how an Omarchy agent can discover, customize, or create what you need.

nodes.name: VideoStoreBar
nodes.author: CallMeBakugo
nodes.description: Bar chip that downloads the link on your clipboard with yt-dlp. Left click: paste. Right click: settings.

nodes.name: Hacker News
nodes.author: batusaribay
nodes.description: Lists recent headlines from THN in the Omarchy bar.

nodes.name: Spinning Disks
nodes.author: Soham Datta
nodes.description: Five transparent spinning wheels on the Omarchy bar that show upload, CPU, memory, disk I/O and download load through speed and colour.

nodes.name: CopyFX
nodes.author: AktOn1
nodes.description: Experimental. Plays an animation on the text you just copied: letters that jump, rain or burst into flowers, right where you selected it. Over 100 effects, a bar menu and a gallery, follows your theme.

nodes.name: Claude Strip
nodes.author: Taylor Burke
nodes.description: A thin strip at the top of each terminal window running Claude Code, showing the session's project, task and running tools. Terminal-agnostic; pair with the session-strip Claude Code mod.

growthMeta.label: End-of-day Git catalog snapshots
growthMeta.detail: Earlier UTC days use the final committed catalog state. The latest UTC day is provisional until a successful later-day build finalizes it.
